chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 122: "Train Elevator
chapters.content:
."
Chen Mang shook his head, clearing his mind of scattered thoughts, before turning his attention to the "Train Ticket" accessory displayed on the control panel screen.
Although it was of white rarity, it was actually quite useful.
Otherwise, it wouldn't have appeared among the craftable accessories for a Level 4 Train.
He had come to realize that as levels increased, relying solely on rapid upgrades to stay ahead of other Trains and survive longer was no longer feasible. One had to venture into Fortuitous Encounter maps or defeat bosses to obtain rare blueprints to truly gain an edge.
The effect of this accessory was the ability to produce Train Tickets.
Guards on field missions could tear a Train Ticket and instantly teleport back to the Train's bound location. The initial teleportation range was 1,000 meters, and it increased to 10,000 meters at Level 10.
This accessory could effectively ensure the safety of field personnel.
Not bad.
In situations where the Train's fire support wasn't timely, this accessory could significantly reduce casualties. Additionally, two Supermodel Effects had been unlocked.
"Train Ticket Level 5 Supermodel Effect": If the teleportation fails, the first-person perspective of the user's last minute before death is transmitted back to the Train.
"Train Ticket Level 10 Supermodel Effect": None.
Overall, this accessory was quite good, though the only regret was the lack of a Level 10 effect. He had hoped that if the accessory level was raised high enough, perhaps even to Level 20 or 50, it might unlock something extraordinary.
Perhaps...
An effect similar to resurrection, where field personnel holding a Train Ticket could be instantly revived inside the Train upon death.
Now, it seemed that wasn't possible.
But then again, such an effect was too fantastical, directly breaking the rules of life and death. Even the "Medical Bay" could only save severely injured people, not resurrect the dead.
With this accessory, he could occasionally venture out.
He could move within a 10,000-meter radius centered on the Train, using the "Hell Staff" to remotely control the Train in case of danger, and if things got too risky, he could teleport back using the Train Ticket.
Nice.
Soon—
The night passed, and it was a restful one, with everyone relaxing.
At dawn.
The "Stellar Train" set off again, heading west towards the city center to search for Yan Yao. For the Stellar Train, rescuing a Survivor was simple, especially with a general description.
The Targeting Radar screen clearly marked nearby life forms.
It was worth noting.
Along the way, the Targeting Radar showed very few Survivors. Most had likely been scavenged by other Trains or had fallen prey to monsters.
Finally!
The Stellar Train slowly entered the park, where approximately thirteen standalone villas were nestled in a corner.
"Quite a few people," Chen Mang glanced at the Targeting Radar, which showed red dots in the basements of seven villas. Did these wealthy people all have their own safe rooms? One villa even had over thirty people inside.
He immediately called Ji Chuchu over the walkie-talkie.
"Take a look at these two people and see which one is Yan Yao."
Among the seven villas, only two had a single red dot. According to Ji Chuchu, Yan Yao should be in one of these two.
"Neither," Ji Chuchu shook her head, quickly scanning the real-time images around each red dot on the screen, before finally focusing on one villa. "Lord Mang, this is Yan Yao. The woman next to her, I don't know who she is."
"Got it."
Chen Mang nodded, looking at the villa with two red dots. Without saying much, he maneuvered the Train into the villa area and came to a halt.
Upon receiving the order, Biao Zi and the others immediately jumped down, forming a cautious three-three formation with their Soaring Dragon Assault Rifles slung across their chests, quickly fanning out towards the villa.
Although the AI had informed them that there was no danger ahead.
It never hurt to be careful.
"Stay alert," Biao Zi, tense, forcefully kicked open the slightly ajar door and looked inside the villa, which was covered in spiderwebs. The blurred footprints on the floor indicated that no one had been here for a long time.
The first thing that caught their eye was the living room with a ceiling height of ten meters.
Under the once exquisite chandelier, a dried-up corpse swayed gently in the breeze.
"Damn it!" Biao Zi cursed under his breath, thoroughly spooked early in the morning. Even in the apocalypse, couldn't people choose a quicker way to die? Didn't they fear being devoured by monsters before they could even hang themselves?
The corpse's legs were missing.
The wounds had completely dried out and turned pale, with splatters of dried brownish-red blood on the floor beneath the corpse.
The legs had likely been gnawed off by leaping monsters, leaving the rest out of reach.
One thing about these monsters was certain—they consumed all human corpses, making this apocalypse at least free from outbreaks of plagues.
Otherwise, with so many bodies in the summer heat, it would have been a disaster.
Directly doubling the apocalypse's difficulty.
Biao Zi shifted his gaze from the corpse—a middle-aged man. A pity, with his plump belly. The monsters had only managed to eat his legs, missing the most meaty part—the belly. The corpse was shriveled, but one could still vaguely see how much meat his belly once held.
The villa's first floor had some blurred footprints.
The second-floor stairs had none.
It seemed that the thugs who had previously looted this villa had only gone through the first floor, completely ignoring the rest. He could understand that. When he was a thug, he would have done the same, avoiding any place that looked eerie.
The Train Conductor's goods were valuable.
But his life was his own.
Why risk it?
Back in the day, if he had seen this scene at the villa's entrance, he wouldn't have stepped inside—too creepy. But today was different.
Biao Zi led the way, following the AI's instructions in his mind, heading straight to the basement and towards the corner safe room. From the outside, it looked like an ordinary room, but he knocked on the wall.
It was extremely thick.
Reinforced with plenty of steel. He tried pushing down on the door handle, then forcefully struck the lock with his rifle butt.
It was a fake door.
The real door was a security door behind the fake one. This was going to be tricky to get into.
"..."
Biao Zi frowned slightly, about to say something when he noticed a swarm of mechanical nanite spiders had somehow crawled into the basement, squeezing through the cracks of the security door.
Seconds later.
With a crisp sound, the security door slowly opened from the inside.
He immediately pushed the door open and looked at the two women trembling in the corner, their faces pale, and said hoarsely, "Do you know Ji Chuchu? She's Lord Mang's—"
At that moment—
"Mei Jia!" Shan Mao Zi, standing behind Biao Zi, suddenly exclaimed, his voice trembling with excitement. "What are you doing here? I've been looking all over Taiping City for you—"
"Wait," Biao Zi, slightly confused, looked at the two women who had been starved thin and frowned. "Are you saying the other woman is your friend?"
"Yes, yes!" Shan Mao Zi said excitedly. "It's her, it's her, it's really her!"
"Shan Mao Zi?"
One of the women hiding in the corner, upon hearing the familiar voice and confirming she wasn't mistaken, instantly teared up. She threw the dagger she had been clutching aside and rushed towards Shan Mao Zi, her voice trembling with sobs. "I never thought I'd see you before I died, I—"
"I didn't either—"
"Alright, alright, enough with the 'I's and 'you's," Biao Zi sighed, interrupting their conversation. "We're on a mission here, keep it professional. You can talk more back on the Train."
"Right," Shan Mao Zi realized he had been a bit too emotional. He took a deep breath, suppressing his feelings, and brought the woman to his side.
"Can you walk?" Biao Zi glanced at the pile of instant food wrappers in the safe room before addressing the woman who was shakily standing up.
There was plenty of food in the room.
And plenty left uneaten. They could take it all back to the Train. It seemed they had enough food and water to last another two or three months.
"I can walk," the tall woman in the corner stood up shakily and looked at Biao Zi's tactical uniform. She took a deep breath. "My father is the head of the Special Operations Bureau in Sand River City. Did he send you to rescue me?"
"Have all the monsters been wiped out?"
"..." Biao Zi pursed his lips, shifting his gaze from the safe room. "The Special Operations Bureau, huh? If your father was a dedicated official, then his death anniversary is probably coming up. If he was a coward, he might still be alive."
"Lord Mang sent me."
"Follow me."
He didn't say much to the woman. Who knew what her status on the Train would be? If she couldn't walk, he'd have to call a couple of female residents to help her. The less said, the better—fewer mistakes that way.
But it seemed...
She hadn't yet grasped the reality that the world had officially entered the apocalypse. Her memories were still stuck at the outbreak's beginning, and it would take time for her to adjust.
"You've got this trick up your sleeve?" In the Stellar Train's control room, Chen Mang looked at Xiao Ai in surprise. "Why haven't you used it before?"
Xiao Ai's emotionless voice came through the robot's speaker.
"I never had the chance before, and I only recently figured out how to use it this way."
"I can multi-task control these mechanical nanite spiders to perform highly precise tasks, allowing them to do more than just repair accessories. However..."
"I can only open relatively simple locks. For more complex ones, I'd need you to find lock-picking materials for me to learn from."
"But this is the limit of my computational power. I can only multi-task control this number of mechanical nanite spiders, and while controlling them, I can't control other accessories."
"Not bad," Chen Mang nodded, then turned his attention to the Targeting Radar on the screen. It showed that during the time they had been parked here, several people had sneaked up to the windows to observe them, but none had made a sound.
It seemed these people didn't want to leave.
At least until their food ran out, staying in the safe room was safer than being on the Train—though that didn't apply to his Train.
And—
He looked at the "Doomsday Marriage Certificate" in the drawer and smiled. An unexpected bonus. Shan Mao Zi's girlfriend, somehow, had made it from Taiping City to the safe room in the Sand River City villa.
Another 100 Inheritance Points.
Though he hadn't used it yet.
But both Inheritance Points and Reputation Points were things you couldn't acquire when you needed them the most. It was always good to stock up in advance. Now he had 200 Inheritance Points.
At that moment—
The Train Radio received a message from the Azure Dragon Train Captain.
"Azure Dragon Train Captain": Bro, are you ready? We might not be able to wait for your two-week deadline. Plans have changed—we'll need to head to the Tower of Heaven by tomorrow at the latest.
"Explain."
"That Fortuitous Encounter map, the Tower of Heaven, officially opens tomorrow. A 'Train Elevator' will descend from the sky to the ground. Even without the ability to climb 90-degree cliffs, you can still get up there."
"I thought it was an exploration-type Fortuitous Encounter map, but it turns out to be a competitive open map, just not open yet."
"I wondered how anyone could explore up there with such harsh conditions. I couldn't even do it, so who else could?"
"This map doesn't allow Level 6 Trains."
"If you're going, bro, then we'll need to meet tomorrow morning and head there together."
"I'm in. Send the coordinates."
"Alright, meet at coordinates '391, 8192, 283' tomorrow morning."
"Three parameters?"
"Oh, right, I almost forgot. Your Train can't fly, so you only need latitude and longitude, no altitude. Just meet at '391, 8192' on the ground."
"..."
Chen Mang looked expressionlessly at the chat message on the Train Radio. Was this guy doing it on purpose?
Even if his Train could fly, would they really meet in the air?
Just wait!
It's not like he couldn't fly. He already had the Bunny Cloud. With a few more acceleration Vehicle Components, he could fly too. Then he'd set the coordinates at '391, 8192, 5000'.
This guy's maximum altitude was only 3,000 meters, limited by the Bunny Cloud's wheel level.
He'd definitely fly higher than this guy.
Good.
He hadn't had the chance to communicate closely with other Trains. He couldn't keep working in isolation. Tomorrow, he'd see how other Trains were developing and see if there was anything he could learn.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 123: The Map of the Goblin Ruins Fortuitous Encounter.
chapters.content:
The supplies had been gathered.
Chen Mang didn't linger in Sand River City for long. He steered the Train out of the city and parked it on a plain. Along the way, he encountered another Train, but upon spotting him from a distance, the other Train detoured.
In this world.
Most Trains still prioritized peaceful development. Even if a Mine was detected, as long as another Train was already mining there, they would usually move on to search for a new Mine.
Normally, conflicts between Trains carried far greater risks than rewards. However, if one could secure a victory without risk, the rewards could be substantial.
For example,
The Train that had been lying in wait for him outside the swamp for who knows how many days. He had just upgraded his missiles and some other components, and his Iron Ore reserves weren't abundant. After looting the resources from that Train, the Iron Ore in his Train Panel reached 570,000 units.
With this much Iron Ore, he could venture into the so-called Tower of Heaven.
Even if he had to spend over ten days inside, he wouldn't have to worry about energy or food shortages, though that might be a bit unrealistic.
He also had 1.15 million units of Copper Ore.
Enough to craft three Level 6 missiles or five Level 5 missiles.
His development was more or less complete. It was time to explore.
Night fell quickly.
That night, Chen Mang parked the Train on the Shahe Plain, about two to three hours away from the coordinates. He planned to set off early the next morning.
Inside the Train.
Chen Mang sat in the Train's cabin, organizing the spoils from the past few days. First, there were the crocodiles he had killed in the swamp. The rewards from these crocodiles were pitiful—no blueprints, no Special Items, just some Crocodile Meat, which was similar to Corpse Meat.
Useless, except perhaps for upgrading the Flesh Train or as a special material for certain components, like Spider Silk.
From the Train that had been lying in wait outside the swamp, aside from some Iron Ore, he had also scavenged 100,000 units of Copper Ore. It was thanks to these 100,000 units that his total Copper Ore reserves had reached 1.15 million.
The rest were just everyday supplies and miscellaneous items. No blueprints or Special Items were found.
Only one thing caught his attention.
「Special Item」: Goblin Ruins Fortuitous Encounter Map.
「Item Effect」: Insert this map into the Train Auxiliary AI to view the specific coordinates of the Fortuitous Encounter.
It was a card-like object.
Entirely black with four large white characters outlined in gold: "Goblin Ruins."
It looked... expensive.
Very well-designed, and it felt substantial in his hand.
He tried inserting the card into a slot next to the Train Auxiliary AI on the control panel. Soon, a coordinate appeared on the screen, about five hours away from his current location, at the westernmost corner of the Shahe Plain.
Near the border of the Kunlun Mountains region.
"."
Chen Mang narrowed his eyes slightly. He was very interested in this Goblin Ruins Fortuitous Encounter Map. He felt a strange connection with Goblins. After coming out of the Tower of Heaven, he would check it out.
The planet in this world was much larger than the one in his previous world.
At least.
In his previous world, it was rare to find such a vast plain with only one main city, surrounded by no trace of towns or villages. Every city seemed like an isolated fortress.
The reason that Train had initially evaded his Targeting Radar was likely because it had obtained something valuable from the Goblin Ruins. Back then, Doba's Train had also managed to avoid his Targeting Radar.
After finishing all this, he let out a light sigh, removed his clothes, and went to bed.
"We'll finally meet."
Under the cover of night on the Shahe Plain, inside the Azure Dragon Train, the Bald Man was meticulously checking the integrity of various Train components, including the stored resources.
Fortuitous Encounter Maps were never without danger.
He had to be fully prepared.
He glanced at his Level 5 Energy Shield and Level 3 Armor, both at 100% integrity—perfectly fine. The rest of the firepower components were also in top condition. The Train was stocked with 170,000 units of Iron Ore and 350,000 units of Copper Ore—more than enough.
After all, his Train was a well-equipped Level 5 Train. He was confident about the upcoming Tower of Heaven expedition.
He knew of a dubious method where the levels of the Energy Shield and Armor could be added together to achieve a higher defense level. For example, a Level 2 Energy Shield plus Level 3 Armor could provide Level 5 defense.
This was equivalent to a Level 5 Energy Shield but saved a lot of Iron Ore, as upgrading Energy Shields was expensive. However, the trade-off was significant—it was shortsighted and not a proper path.
And—
Initially, he had invited Chen Mang because, although he knew the coordinates, he had no means to reach the Tower of Heaven Fortuitous Encounter Map. Tomorrow, the Tower of Heaven would officially open, and Train Elevators would descend from the sky to carry the Trains up. He no longer needed Chen Mang.
But he had still shared the information with Chen Mang.
Partly as a gesture of goodwill.
A Train with S-class potential and 57—no, 68 Supermodel Effects was definitely worth befriending.
"Sigh."
The Bald Man looked at the leaderboard showing the Stellar Train's Supermodel Effects, which had now increased to 68, and let out a helpless sigh. This guy was outrageous. Where did all those Supermodel Effects come from?
The Stellar Train had been on the Shahe Plain for a while now, yet no one on the Train Radio had spoken a single disrespectful word about it.
Clearly, even though the Stellar Train was only Level 4, no one wanted to provoke such a monster.
It was indeed outrageous.
As for the other reason, of course... he wanted to subtly settle a small grudge. Goodwill aside, he still had to make Chen Mang aware that he wasn't weak—it was just that Chen Mang was too strong.
Inside the Stellar Train.
Biao Zi looked at Shan Mao Zi and his girlfriend, who were practically fused together, and couldn't help but feel a twinge of envy. "Shan Mao Zi, you lucky bastard. Even in the apocalypse, you managed to find your family."
Shan Mao Zi's girlfriend wasn't stunningly beautiful, with faint freckles on her face.
But the freckles didn't detract from her appearance; instead, she had a delicate, charming look—a beauty among ordinary people.
She'd score a six or seven out of ten, especially since makeup wasn't a thing in the apocalypse. With a bit of light makeup, she'd easily hit seven or eight.
"Heh."
Shan Mao Zi hugged his girlfriend tightly, his eyes filled with excitement. "Biao Ge, I've already explained the rules of the Stellar Train to her. From now on, she'll join everyone in mining, and we'll earn Stellar Coupons together, aiming to buy our own place on the Stellar Train as soon as possible."
"No rush."
Biao Zi shook his head. After being separated for so long, it was hard to say how much of their feelings remained. If they could smoothly receive the Doomsday Marriage Certificate from Lord Mang tomorrow, everything would be fine. Lord Mang might even start them off with Level 1 resident treatment. But if they failed, they'd have to start from scratch.
"Didn't you ask her why she left without a word before the apocalypse?"
"I did."
Shan Mao Zi's eyes flashed with sadness, but he forced a smile. "Just as Train Conductor Zhu guessed, she was diagnosed with ALS before the apocalypse. It's a terminal illness, almost incurable. Now, she has trouble speaking and doesn't have many years left."
"But in the apocalypse, every extra year of life is a bonus. When she can't mine anymore, I'll support her. I'll use Stellar Coupons to buy food for her. Biao Ge, don't worry, she won't drain the Train's resources for nothing."
"ALS?"
Biao Zi frowned as he looked at the woman in Shan Mao Zi's arms. Indeed, her body seemed a bit stiff. This disease was incurable. She was tough—if he had ALS and found himself in the apocalypse, he might have just ended it all. Where did she find the courage to keep living?
"How did you end up in Yan Yao's Safehouse?"
"B-Biao Ge," the woman's voice was hoarse as she whispered, "I don't know. I was in a village in Taiping City when monsters started killing people everywhere. I just remember passing out, and when I woke up, I was in Sister Yan Yao's safehouse."
"Alright, I see. Tonight, you'll share a bed with Shan Mao Zi. We'll discuss further after Lord Mang wakes up tomorrow."
Biao Zi paused, then looked at Shan Mao Zi with a serious expression. "She's been in the safehouse all this time and doesn't know much about the outside world. Shan Mao Zi, you must explain everything clearly to her."
"Many rules from peaceful times no longer apply here."
"The apocalypse has its own rules, and the Stellar Train has its own rules."
"If she breaks any rules..."
"She'll die."
"Understand?"
"I understand, Biao Ge," Shan Mao Zi replied solemnly, tightly gripping his girlfriend's hand as if afraid she might disappear again in the next second.
Meanwhile, in the No. 5 Female Advanced Talent Carriage.
Yan Yao's face was pale, her expression one of disbelief as she stared at Ji Chuchu. "Ji Chuchu, do you realize what you're saying?"
"You're telling me this Train is the best place to be in the apocalypse?"
"Today, I saw many people crammed into a carriage with just a blanket on the floor. Some were even sleeping in the Refrigerator, without mattresses, just lying on the ground. There were even women openly soliciting customers. And you call this Train the only hope in the apocalypse?"
"Ji Chuchu!"
"You weren't like this before!"
"."
Ji Chuchu's expression was complex as she looked at Yan Yao, a trace of jealousy and envy hidden deep in her eyes. She turned to gaze out the window at the starry sky, silent for a long time, before murmuring softly.
"Yan Yao, do you know how jealous I am of you? How envious?"
"This chair you're sitting on, the bed beside it where you can lie down, the clean sheets and pillows, the ample food and water every day."
"Do you know that these things..."
"I only got to enjoy them after coming to the Stellar Train? Do you know what my life was like in the early days of the apocalypse?"
"Worse than a dog's."
"I didn't even dare to sleep, afraid I'd be torn to pieces by monsters in my dreams."
"And you?"
"After the apocalypse, you didn't have to worry about food or monsters, hiding in your safehouse until the Stellar Train came to rescue you. Go ask any member of this Train, even those women you despise for soliciting customers. Ask them, and every single one will tell you how grateful they are to the Stellar Train."
"Before the Stellar Train, there was no such thing as soliciting customers."
"The Stellar Train gave them the right to do so. If you think the people in those carriages are crowded, I really wish you could see the other Trains."
"It's so unfair, do you know that?"
"I've suffered through so much, yet you've experienced none of it. But the fortune I've found, you've gotten it all."
"Before the apocalypse, it was the same. You had an official father backing you, and every time you faced trouble, I'd smile and shield you. After the apocalypse, it's even more so. Lord Mang will favor you even more, just because you're a virgin."
"But..."
"You don't realize any of this, taking it all for granted."
Yan Yao's face was pale but resolute as she shook her head.
"Ji Chuchu, I'm not stubborn."
"Perhaps the Stellar Train's conditions are indeed good in the apocalypse, but I'm still a lady. I can't accept using my body to serve Lord Mang. I'd rather go mining."
"."
Ji Chuchu was silent for a long time before speaking softly. "Are you sure?"
"I'm sure."
"Of course, the Stellar Train gives everyone ample choice." Ji Chuchu pulled out a walkie-talkie from under the table and spoke into it. "Train Conductor Zhu, please send someone to take Yan Yao to the rear carriages. She's chosen to go mining."
"What are you doing?"
Yan Yao's face changed. "There are so many empty beds here. Can't I sleep here tonight?"
"You?"
Ji Chuchu shook her head, suddenly smiling. "This is Level 3 Advanced Talent treatment. You're currently a Level 3 resident. This isn't where you should be."
"Forgot to mention."
"All residents must mine at least 10 units per day. Only by exceeding this can they enjoy the corresponding treatment benefits."
"If you fall short, Biao Ge will show you just how round his baton can swing."
"I'll mine!" Yan Yao gritted her teeth, watching as several men pushed open the carriage door and entered. "I, Yan Yao, would rather die than rely on my body to survive!"
The smile on Ji Chuchu's face froze slightly before fading, her voice calm.
"No, you've got it wrong. As long as you mine diligently, you won't starve on the Stellar Train, and no one will kill you."
"You won't die."
"This place is much safer than your safehouse."

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 124 "Aren't you... Ji Ji Chuchu?"
chapters.content:
Inside Carriage No. 5.
After taking Yan Yao away, Lao Zhu walked in and smiled warmly at Ji Chuchu, who was sitting by the bed, "Looks like it didn't go well, huh? Wasn't this what you promised Lord Mang?"
"Don't end up burning yourself in the process."
He could naturally see through Ji Chuchu's intentions. She had reached her limit and wanted to use Yan Yao to elevate her status on the train. However, it seemed things weren't progressing as smoothly as she had hoped.
"It's a bit troublesome."
Ji Chuchu shook her head, turning to look out the window, "She hasn't experienced the apocalypse yet. Her mindset hasn't shifted. Give her some time, and she'll come around."
Lao Zhu nodded, "Just make sure you don't overdo it. Don't force anything if she's unwilling. Let her mine if she wants. Lord Mang doesn't like unnecessary complications, understand?"
"Yes, I understand, Train Conductor Zhu."
"Good." Lao Zhu didn't say more and turned to leave the carriage. It was just a minor incident. Since Yan Yao was brought into the carriage, Lord Mang hadn't even asked about her, showing he didn't care much. She seemed more like an optional presence.
If she obeyed, she could stay. If not, she'd be treated like any other resident.
She could mine or sell herself.
Soon, dawn broke.
The bald man in the Azure Dragon Train switched to the Wind-Fire Wheel, speeding toward the coordinates. The Bunny Cloud consumed too much energy. Flying over the Kunshan region was necessary due to the rough terrain, and it was safer in the air.
But on the Shahe Plain, using the Wind-Fire Wheel was more efficient. Flying in the air would be pure stupidity, no matter how rich you were. Resources weren't meant to be wasted like that.
However.
When they were just a few minutes away from the coordinates, the Azure Dragon Train gradually came to a halt. Several mechanical arms extended from the sides of the carriages, and within a minute, the wheels were replaced with Bunny Clouds.
Then, as the nitrogen tailjets on both sides of the carriages ignited, the train surged forward, flying straight toward the coordinates!
Not long after.
He spotted the Stellar Train parked near the coordinates in his field of vision. He chuckled, then slowly maneuvered the train to land in front of the Stellar Train, leaning out of the window to wave.
"Bro! It's me!"
"..."
Chen Mang expressionlessly looked at the train that had landed before him. His Targeting Radar had been upgraded to level 15, with a detection range of 15,000 meters. He had already spotted the Azure Dragon Train on his radar.
When it was over ten thousand meters away, it was still on the ground.
After stopping for a minute, it flew over.
It was clear.
The Bunny Cloud must consume a lot of energy.
But he didn't expose it, just sighed lightly. This guy acted like a child. It's the apocalypse, are you playing house?
He also rolled down his window and leaned out to inspect the Azure Dragon Train.
"Long time no see. Nice train."
"Not bad." The bald man chuckled, "Level 5 train, 22 carriages, over 600 Slaves. Let's head out now. I'll lead the way. My train's faster, maxing out at over 500 on flat ground. I'll go slower."
"Just over 300."
"Alright."
Neither of them got out of their trains, just poking their heads out to chat for a bit.
After all, it was their first meeting.
The Azure Dragon Train Captain didn't dare to step out alone for a chat. Most of a Train Captain's abilities came from the train. Leaving it would significantly increase the danger. Chen Mang didn't mind, even though he had the Hell Staff to remotely control the train.
But...
There was still danger. Bullets weren't slow.
The two trains sped eastward across the Shahe Plain, the opposite direction of the Kunlun Mountains, which lay to the west. The Tower of Heaven was to the east.
About three hours later.
The Azure Dragon Train gradually slowed down and stopped in front of a Tower of Heaven.
'We're here. We'll have to wait a bit.'
Chen Mang glanced at the message from the Azure Dragon Train Captain on the Train Radio and looked at the scene before him, feeling a hint of awe. The tower in front of him seemed to be a hundred meters in diameter, like a giant utility pole.
But it was more sci-fi.
Its surface was transparent, revealing numerous gears of various shapes turning inside. Some gears were dozens of meters in diameter, turning slowly, while others were only a few centimeters, spinning rapidly.
Looking up.
The higher you went, the narrower the tower became. At the very top, it was only ten meters wide, with a massive platform above it. The entire structure looked like an exaggeratedly proportioned golden mushroom.
This was definitely not a pre-apocalypse creation.
In front of the Tower of Heaven was a massive light curtain, resembling a regional boundary.
'Fortuitous Encounter Map: Tower of Heaven.'
'Countdown to Activation: 01:10:29.'
'Maximum of 8 trains allowed to ascend and participate. Only Level 5 and below trains permitted.'
'No attacks allowed between trains in the yellow waiting area. No attacks allowed between members of different trains.'
"Bro!"
The Azure Dragon Train Captain had already jumped off the train with his trusted aides and stood on the plain, pointing at the yellow circle in the distance, waving, "We're in the yellow waiting area now. It's safe here. You can come down."
"Let's go."
Chen Mang picked up the walkie-talkie and whispered, "Lao Zhu, bring Biao Zi down with you."
Just then—
Xiao Ai, who had been quietly standing in the corner of the train room, suddenly spoke up, "Train Captain, I'd like to go down and take a look too."
"You?"
Chen Mang frowned slightly, about to refuse, but then thought better of it. He picked up the staff beside him, walked to the mirror to tidy up his appearance, then said, "Alright, let's go down together."
Then he stepped off the train.
"Bro!"
The bald man from the Azure Dragon Train, along with his subordinates, immediately approached Chen Mang as he got off, his face full of smiles, "We've been communicating for so long, finally meeting in person. That maze design of yours was truly ingenious. I admire you, bro."
"I'm Er Dan. What should I call you?"
Then, when his gaze fell on Chen Mang's clothes, he was slightly stunned. Weren't these also made on the Clothing Customization Production Line? Why did his clothes look so much better in quality?
And that staff looked so luxurious!
Moreover.
This is the apocalypse. Why does this guy have an aura of detachment from the mundane world? His presence is extraordinary.
He had been quite confident in his own attire, but now, for some reason, he felt a surge of inferiority. He subconsciously looked down at his own clothes. Could it be that this guy upgraded the Clothing Customization Production Line to have a Supermodel Effect?
"Just call me Chen Mang."
Chen Mang, accompanied by Lao Zhu and the others, walked up to the bald man and smiled, "Your head's pretty shiny, bro."
Both being Train Captains, their auras were completely different.
Indeed.
It was all about money.
His clothes were the result of a Level 10 Supermodel Effect from the Clothing Customization Production Line, crafting high-precision clothes. That staff was also a Special Item, the Hell Staff. His body had been completely transformed in the Medical Bay, and with his already good looks and height, he stood out.
Especially in the apocalypse.
The contrast was even more striking.
Only after stepping off the train could one truly feel the awe-inspiring presence of the transparent Tower of Heaven. Chen Mang looked up at the towering structure and the countless gears turning inside, thinking it looked incredibly cool.
If only he could collect this.
It would make a fantastic addition to his collection.
Then he glanced around. Currently, only their two trains were in the yellow area. No other trains were in sight, and the Targeting Radar showed no other trains within range.
"Just the two of us?"
"Yeah."
The Azure Dragon Train Captain, Er Dan, nodded seriously, "Not many know about the Tower of Heaven's activation. I've been keeping an eye on it. Plus, Fortuitous Encounter maps always have some danger. Many prefer to just mine safely, reducing the risk."
"Chen Mang."
"No matter how many trains show up later, let's stick to our agreement. If it's cooperative, we'll team up and split the rewards 50-50. If it's individual challenges, we'll each rely on our own skills. What do you say?"
"Alright. What if it's adversarial?"
"There are no adversarial Fortuitous Encounter maps." Er Dan shook his head, "At least, I've never encountered or heard of any."
At this point.
"Mom!"
Er Dan suddenly turned and shouted toward the train room, "Make some ice-cold beer. I'm treating my bro to a drink."
"Excuse me, everyone. My mother passed away early, so I named the AI 'Mom.' It feels like she's still with me."
"I enjoy exploring Fortuitous Encounters, so I've gathered many interesting accessories, like this ice-cold beer production line. It's not very useful, but it improves quality of life."
A door on one of the Azure Dragon Train's carriages opened, and a beautiful woman in a short skirt walked out, carrying a tray with over a dozen cans of beer.
"Have a taste. It's been a while since you've had some, right?"
Er Dan enthusiastically invited Chen Mang and his group, "Come on, try some. We've got some time left. Let's sit and enjoy. In the apocalypse, moments like this are rare."
'These are indeed accessories-produced beers. No harm.'
'Also, Train Captain, could you ask Er Dan if his train has A-level potential? I'm quite curious.'
"..."
Chen Mang ignored the message from the AI in his mind and, without putting on any airs, sat cross-legged on the ground like Er Dan and the others, opening a beer and taking a hearty sip.
"Bro, let me tell you, that maze of yours..."
Though this guy seemed a bit showy.
They clicked well and had a good chat. Lao Zhu and the others also gathered with Er Dan's subordinates, chatting away. The group sat cross-legged on the plain, none of them carrying any weapons.
If it weren't for the two heavily armored trains parked on either side.
It wouldn't look like the apocalypse at all.
More like a peaceful spring outing.
But the several gun turrets mounted outside the carriages brought the atmosphere back to the apocalypse.
"Bro!"
After two cans of beer, Er Dan wasn't drunk but was in high spirits. He looked at Chen Mang seriously, "We really hit it off. Here's the thing: I know the Stellar Train has S-level potential, but it's only a Level 4 train. It might lack some accessories."
"Later, I'll produce a few thousand more cans of beer and give them to you!"
"Anytime you want to drink, just take them."
"But..."
Er Dan suddenly laughed, pulling the beautiful woman in the short skirt into his arms, winking, "This woman, though, I can't give to you. She's mine. How about it? She's pretty, right? Having such a beauty in the apocalypse isn't easy."
"Call him Lord Mang!"
The woman in Er Dan's arms obediently whispered, "Lord Mang."
"..."
Chen Mang, sitting cross-legged on the ground, couldn't help but sigh again. This guy was always showing off. Who asked for your woman? Really...
He glanced at Lao Zhu beside him.
Though Lao Zhu was chatting with others, his attention had been on this side. He immediately understood and nodded slightly, taking out the walkie-talkie and whispering a few words.
The next moment—
The door of Carriage No. 5 on the Stellar Train opened.
Ji Chuchu, in a red evening gown, with bright eyes and white teeth, stood at the door, gracefully waving to everyone. She walked elegantly to the group, knelt beside Chen Mang, and smiled without saying a word.
Then she took out a cigar, quietly lit it, and handed it to Chen Mang with both hands.
She looked both stunning and obedient.
"Oh."
Chen Mang took the cigar, pinching it between his fingers, and smiled at Er Dan, "No worries. A friend's wife is off-limits. How could I take your woman? Keep her for yourself."
This cigar was one of seven he had seized from a train outside the swamp.
He didn't like smoking them, but they added a certain flair.
"Huh?"
Er Dan, who had been all smiles, froze at this sight, his eyes filled with disbelief and shock. His voice rose involuntarily, "Aren't you... Ji Ji Chuchu?"
"The top-tier celebrity, the C-position guest on the hottest pre-apocalypse variety show 'Sisters, Please Step Up'?"
"That's me."
Ji Chuchu, kneeling beside Chen Mang, tucked a strand of hair behind her ear and smiled radiantly, "Thanks to Lord Mang taking me in, I have a place to call home in the apocalypse."
"I... I..."
Er Dan's eyes flashed with confusion. He looked at Ji Chuchu in her stunning red evening gown, exuding elegance and nobility beside Chen Mang, then at the woman in the short skirt by his side.
They were not on the same level.
After a long pause, he forced a stiff smile, his face somewhat embarrassed as he looked at Chen Mang, "Bro, you're living the good life."
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 125: Can I Apply to Withdraw? He's Done Playing.
chapters.content:
"Not bad."
Chen Mang couldn't help but laugh, pulling Ji Chuchu into his arms and glancing at the woman in the miniskirt next to Er Dan. "Bro, you... you seem well-fed too."
"Can I still get those beers we talked about earlier?"
"Of course, why not!"
Er Dan spoke with a serious expression, "A bottle of beer is just one unit of Iron Ore. I, Er Dan, don't lack such things. Someone, move these to the Stellar Train!"
The next moment—
The carriage of the Azure Dragon Train opened, and dozens of Slaves jumped off, carrying crates of beer toward the Stellar Train.
Meanwhile, the Stellar Train's carriage also opened, and under Biao Zi's direction, a group of Train Residents jumped off to receive the beer and toss it onto the train.
"This—"
Er Dan, who was about to say something, looked at the group of Slaves from the Stellar Train and suddenly flashed a look of shock. After a long pause, he murmured, "Bro, how come your Slaves all look so healthy?"
"Ah, that."
Chen Mang clicked his tongue. How should he explain this? He couldn't exactly say that the bread and other things he gave them could enhance their physical fitness and supply essential vitamins. "Maybe it's because I feed them well."
"How many people die on average each month from mining in your place?"
"Die? None."
"No one gets sick?"
"Nope."
"How's that possible? Are your Slaves made of iron or something?"
"Bro... bro."
A Slave from the Azure Dragon Train, who was carrying a crate of beer to hand to a Slave from the Stellar Train, suddenly looked alarmed and whispered, "Are you crazy? Your Train Conductor is sitting right there. How dare you smoke so openly as a Slave?"
"If the Thugs find out you've been hiding cigarettes, you're dead!"
"Huh?"
The man who had jumped off the Stellar Train was momentarily stunned before he realized what was happening. He exhaled a puff of smoke casually and laughed, "What are you talking about? I'm not a Slave. I'm a Level 1 Resident now. This cigarette was bought with Stellar Coupons. Why can't I smoke it?"
"Just hand me the beer."
"Level 1 Resident treatment? What does that mean?"
"It means we can earn Stellar Coupons from mining, and then use them to buy things on the train, like cigarettes, houses, and—"
"Wait, what do you mean by houses?"
"Uh, I can't say. There are rules on the train. I can't reveal classified information. This is classified. But yeah, we have them."
"Don't your Thugs whip you to make you work?"
"Why would we need someone to whip us to work?"
"Huh? Don't you get tired?"
"Tired?" The man from the Stellar Train thought for a moment before holding up the crate of beer the Slave had handed him with one hand. "This is also classified. I can't tell you. But my physical condition keeps improving. I don't feel tired at all. I even have cola every day. I've got endless energy."
"Cola?"
"Yeah, that's classified too."
"Why is everything classified?"
"I didn't think about it until you asked. But yeah, it seems like everything's classified. At first, it was tiring, but it got much better later. It's way better than when I was on other trains. Plus, we have something to look forward to."
The man's eyes were filled with satisfaction and pride as he smiled and said, "Our treatment keeps improving. We can use the Stellar Coupons we earn to buy assets on the train. We can even find a wife and start a family again in this apocalypse."
"Do you have something to look forward to?"
"Yeah, I look forward to dying sooner."
The Slave from the Azure Dragon Train cautiously glanced at his Train Conductor, who was sitting cross-legged not far away, then lowered his voice, his eyes filled with longing and urgency. "Can I join your train?"
"Hmm."
The man thought for a moment before turning his head to look at Lord Mang not far away. "I'm afraid that's not possible. It could lead to war, and I don't have the authority to decide."
"I see."
The Slave from the Azure Dragon Train gritted his teeth and glanced back at the other Slaves from the Azure Dragon Train, whose eyes were also red. He whispered urgently, "All of us want to join the Stellar Train. Can you ask your Train Conductor? If it's possible, we'll start a riot from within as soon as you attack."
"The bullets are all stored in Carriage 2."
"When the time comes, we'll rush to Carriage 2 and blow it up. You can take advantage of the chaos to attack!"
"This—"
The man was stunned for a moment before his expression turned serious. "Wait here. I'll pass this message to Biao Ge."
"Alright, I'll wait for your signal!"
"..."
Chen Mang's face remained expressionless as Biao Zi whispered the report into his ear. His lips twitched slightly, and he sighed as he looked at Er Dan, who was still in shock.
Buddy, wise up.
Can't you see the look in your Slaves' eyes?
He then waved his hand, signaling Biao Zi to reject the proposal.
At this moment, Er Dan finally snapped out of his daze and murmured, "Bro... did your train change its system? Your Slaves all seem so motivated, nothing like the oppressed ones I have."
"Yeah, we changed it."
"Can you tell me about it?"
"Of course."
Half an hour later.
Er Dan frowned deeply, pondering Chen Mang's words. It might be a bit more complicated, but it seemed much better than the Slave system. The people on the Stellar Train were clearly full of energy, unlike his own Slaves, who were lifeless.
Especially—
Under this system, the Slaves' enthusiasm for work was much higher. The Slaves on the Stellar Train even worked up to seventeen or eighteen hours a day!
Moreover, Chen Mang hadn't held back. He'd even told him about the Bread Slices that could enhance physical fitness and the cola that restored energy. But where would he get the Murphy Stones to upgrade these two white Life Modules? Even if he had them, he wouldn't waste them on white Life Modules.
After a long pause, Er Dan shook his head with a bitter smile. "Bro, I can't use your system. You've got too many Supermodel Effects. I don't have nearly as many."
"Someone like you is truly one of a kind in this apocalypse."
"Now I'm worried that after my Slaves interact with yours, they'll all want to join the Stellar Train."
"That's true."
Chen Mang nodded in agreement. Without so many Supermodel Effects, an ordinary person would've been exhausted working like this long ago. "That's why I told you from the start. This system isn't exactly classified. It's not a big deal to share it. But without the proper Life Modules, it's hard to implement."
"Right."
Er Dan nodded, frowning as he thought deeply. "But it's given me some inspiration. I'll go back and see if I can come up with some incentive system too."
Then.
He took a deep breath, his eyes filled with admiration and helplessness as he looked at Chen Mang. "I've made a fool of myself in front of you, bro. I lost some face in your maze. I came here to vent, but I didn't expect that even though you're only a Level 4 Train, you're stronger than me in every way."
"No wonder you're the first Mechanical Train with S-grade potential in the Shahe Plain."
"Even in terms of women, I can't compare."
At that moment—
The door of Carriage 5 opened again, and Yan Yao, wearing a tank dress, walked down with a smile. She went to Chen Mang's side and knelt down, her voice filled with shyness as she whispered, "Lord Mang."
"Yan... Yan Yao?!"
Er Dan's eyes flashed with shock again. "You're that celebrity from the entertainment industry with the big background? You... Chen... Chen Mang, you..."
But the most stunned wasn't Er Dan—it was Ji Chuchu.
Ji Chuchu looked at Yan Yao, who was sitting on the other side of Lord Mang, completely bewildered. She was even wearing her clothes! Didn't you say last night that you'd rather go mining? How did you change so much in just one night!
Soon, Ji Chuchu figured it out. She gritted her teeth, cursing in her heart, calling her a scheming bitch.
She even took a shower and used her lipstick!
Are you out of your mind?!
Chen Mang glanced at Yan Yao, who was kneeling beside him, and gave her a once-over. Her beauty was on par with Ji Chuchu's, but while Ji Chuchu's beauty evoked a sense of pity, Yan Yao's was more aloof.
He then looked at Er Dan, whose jaw was practically on the floor, and couldn't help but laugh.
"You know them too?"
"They're big celebrities! Who doesn't know them!"
"Not bad." Chen Mang glanced at the countdown on the screen. "The countdown's almost up. Looks like it's just our two trains this time. Let's head back."
With that.
He stood up, bid farewell to Er Dan, and walked toward the train cabin with Xiao Ai, leaning on his cane. The others returned to their respective carriages.
"What's going on with you?"
Inside Carriage 5, Ji Chuchu crossed her arms and looked at Yan Yao in disbelief, unable to stop herself from raising her voice. "Are you out of your mind? Didn't you say last night that you'd rather go mining?"
"..."
Yan Yao lowered her head, a bit embarrassed. "I admit I was a bit stubborn last night. There were too many people in the Refrigerator. I couldn't sleep all night. I thought... it's more comfortable staying in this carriage."
"Why did you decide to come down?"
"After the Residents' carriage opened, I saw you sitting next to Lord Mang. I thought if I went down too, Lord Mang would look even more impressive, and he'd probably like me more. Plus, it was my first time seeing him. He's much more handsome than I imagined. So I went to your carriage, took a shower, and put on your clothes before coming down."
"Wait—"
Ji Chuchu took a deep breath, still unable to understand. "Did someone give you advice?"
"Yeah."
Yan Yao threw herself into Ji Chuchu's arms, her eyes filled with guilt as she gently bit Ji Chuchu's ear. "A minor celebrity from before the apocalypse gave me some advice. Then I found out that you were the one who begged Lord Mang to come to Sand River City to save me."
"Thank you."
"If it weren't for you, I'd have been waiting to die after the food ran out."
"Good that you know."
Ji Chuchu pushed Yan Yao away, annoyed. "Do you know how much courage it took for me to beg Lord Mang? After saving you, you were still reluctant. You need to adjust your attitude."
"So what now?" Yan Yao hesitated. "Should I go report to Lord Mang?"
"No, he'll call for you when he needs you."
"Does Lord Mang like you?"
"He likes me. Lord Mang has only called for me."
"I mean romantically."
"..." Ji Chuchu looked at Yan Yao in disbelief. "Are you out of your mind? Don't tell me you've decided after one night to climb the ranks and become the second-in-command? If you've got the skills, fine, but I'm worried you'll get yourself killed."
"This is the apocalypse, people die. You don't think that if you divorce, you'll get half the assets, or if you break up, you'll get half the train, do you?"
"No, I'm just asking. I'm not that stupid, Chuchu. Does Lord Mang have any quirks?"
"Yeah, he likes watching variety shows."
"..."
Sitting in the train cabin, Chen Mang calmly watched the countdown on the screen approach zero.
The moment it hit zero.
The countless gears in the Tower of Heaven suddenly stopped turning, and a crisp clicking sound rang out. After a three-second pause, the gears began to spin wildly again.
Then—
On the massive platform at the top of the Tower of Heaven, eight large platforms suspended by steel cables slowly descended from the sky until they touched the ground.
Chen Mang exchanged a glance with Er Dan, who was in the Azure Dragon Train's cabin.
Then, they each maneuvered their trains onto the platforms in front of them.
The platforms were long enough to accommodate trains with over thirty carriages.
Once the trains were in place.
Several clamps emerged from the bottom of the platforms, firmly securing the train wheels. After a three-minute wait, the platforms began to rise slowly.
Chen Mang looked out the window at the shrinking scenery, feeling a mix of anticipation and nervousness about what awaited them on the platform above the Tower of Heaven. This was his first time entering a Fortuitous Encounter map, so he couldn't help but feel a bit tense.
About five minutes later.
The platforms, pulled by the steel cables, ascended to the five-thousand-meter-high platform. With the sound of gears, the platforms seamlessly merged with the platform, leaving no visible gaps. The clamps on the platforms slowly retracted.
They had officially arrived at the top of the Tower of Heaven!
This was the Fortuitous Encounter map of the Tower of Heaven!
"Huh?"
Sitting in the train cabin, Chen Mang narrowed his eyes as he took in the scenery on the platform. The first thing that caught his eye were eight straight, long roads designed for trains, stretching several hundred meters. At the end of these roads was a—
Massive Mechanical City!!!
A city composed of countless mechanical parts, gears, and more, it appeared long abandoned, devoid of any signs of life.
The first impression was desolation.
The second impression was... power!
On the countless skyscrapers of this Mechanical City, one could clearly see numerous massive anti-aircraft guns mounted on the rooftops. However, it seemed as if the city had suffered a devastating attack, with many buildings collapsed into ruins.
Not a single corpse was in sight.
Nor was there any greenery.
If a city has no greenery, it exudes an overwhelming sense of coldness. This city was exactly that.
"Phew..."
Chen Mang exhaled softly, his hands resting on the control stick. If the mission of this Fortuitous Encounter map was to navigate through this fully armed Mechanical City.
Then he only had one thing to say.
Can I apply to withdraw? He's done playing.
