chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 130: "Iris Chip Level 10 Supermodel Effect."
chapters.content:
The Azure Dragon Train, which had just landed on the ground, saw this light screen and, without hesitation, immediately turned away from the area.
Chen Mang narrowed his eyes slightly, looking at the words "Restricted Area," and also left the vicinity.
On the Shahe Plain.
Chen Mang stepped off the train and gazed at the "Tower of Heaven" several hundred meters away. The tower, entirely transparent with countless gears inside, had stopped turning. It had transformed from a Fortuitous Encounter map into a Restricted Area.
Restricted Area.
This was the first time he had seen these words.
Staying for more than 10 seconds would result in severe attacks. From whom? Perhaps there were still some residual firepower weapons in the Mechanical City, but the city had already completely collapsed into ruins.
However, he wasn't foolish enough to test it.
Although all the gears had stopped turning, from a distance, it still looked magnificent and awe-inspiring. The Tower of Heaven resembled the first time humans built the Tower of Babel—absurd yet filled with strong conviction.
The five levels of this Fortuitous Encounter map, including the S-level difficulty, were much simpler than he had imagined.
It didn't feel like levels.
More like a legacy.
A legacy from the mechanical civilization.
Especially the special item, the "Mechanical Heart." Chen Mang looked at his cane, which now had a ruby the size of a baby's fist embedded at the top, adding a touch of nobility to the cane. This ruby was the Mechanical Heart.
When these two items were placed together, they automatically fused.
As if they were originally one.
"Brother!"
At this moment, Er Dan jumped down from the train room of the Azure Dragon, which was parked nearby. After taking a deep breath, he said with some regret, "This Fortuitous Encounter map was probably the simplest one I've ever encountered. Although I don't know the contents of the last two levels, from what you said, the fourth level was just an animation, so it shouldn't be difficult either."
"Of course, the rewards were also quite pitiful."
"I passed three levels and only got 10,000 units of Iron Ore and two blueprints, one of which was even a White Accessory Blueprint."
"I assume the reward for your final S-level challenge was also quite low, right?"
"Hmm."
Chen Mang paused for a moment before replying softly, "I got a Blue Grade Blueprint. Not bad, at least it wasn't a wasted trip. I still have to thank you for this journey."
"No problem."
Er Dan waved his hand, and a group of Slaves jumped down from the carriage, carrying boxes of beer to the Stellar Train: "I noticed your people really enjoy this beer, so I'll give you another 2,000 cans. I don't have much else to offer, just these."
"Actually, the rewards this time weren't bad, but considering it was an S-level challenge, only getting a Blue Grade Accessory Blueprint... Last time, if I had completed that S-level maze, I could've gotten 30 Murphy Stones. The rewards were much better than a Blue Grade Accessory Blueprint."
"But it's fine."
"I've always liked exploring hidden maps. Next time I find a suitable one, I'll contact you, and we can try it together again. This time, if it weren't for you, I wouldn't have even passed the third level. Thanks, man."
Chen Mang looked at the sincere Er Dan and smiled, then gestured to Lao Zhu beside him: "I'm afraid I don't have much to offer either. Here's some Bread Slices. Long-term consumption can slightly improve physical fitness. Better than nothing, right?"
"You can store them in the Refrigerator. If you eat them for a year or two, your physical fitness will definitely improve."
"Alright."
Er Dan didn't refuse and accepted the gift generously before walking back to his train room with a grin: "Alright, see you next time, brother."
After bidding farewell to Er Dan.
Chen Mang didn't set off immediately. It was still noon, and they had only spent about two hours in the Tower of Heaven Fortuitous Encounter map.
He had no specific goals next.
Just to continue searching for and mining ore.
But before heading out to mine, Chen Mang sat in the train room and reviewed his gains from this trip. The biggest reward was naturally the special item, the "Mechanical Heart." Although the S-level task was extremely simple, the reward was anything but weak.
Special Item: Mechanical Heart.
Special Effect: Can create basic train accessories such as chainsaws, lighters, display screens, etc. Accessories that require energy can be connected to the Generator. Different accessories consume different amounts of energy.
The created accessories cannot be upgraded and are not counted in the train's total accessories.
They're more like basic living facilities.
The effect is quite useful.
For example, if he found a pre-apocalypse display in the City Ruins, even if he found it, he couldn't use it. The lack of a host computer was secondary; the main issue was the inability to supply power. The Generator on the Train can only power post-apocalyptic train accessories—they're not from the same system.
But items created with the Mechanical Heart can all be connected to the Generator.
For standalone use, Energy Stones can also be embedded.
Although it can only create basic accessories, the fact that it can create anything based on imagination alone makes this special item inherently valuable. It's definitely worthy of an S-level challenge reward.
If given the choice between the Mechanical Heart and 30 Murphy Stones, he would definitely choose the former.
Murphy Stones are useless to him.
They can only be sold or traded with other trains. With his 0-level permission for Infinite Upgrade, Murphy Stones are essentially redundant.
This special item will greatly improve the current ecosystem within the train.
"Not bad."
Chen Mang played with the cane in his hand, quite satisfied with the rewards from this Fortuitous Encounter map. However, the difficulty of this map was clearly low, and the rewards didn't match the difficulty at all.
It felt more like a legacy.
The second level's memory test was extremely difficult, but in the fifth level, such strong memory wasn't needed. With just his memory, he could remember those words.
He had a feeling.
This Fortuitous Encounter map would reappear one day, and at that time, the images and information stored in Li Shiji's mind would truly come into play. That would be the moment the entire Fortuitous Encounter map was fully unveiled.
Then he looked at the White Accessory Blueprint he obtained from the second level.
Iris Chip.
"..."
When he looked at the accessory information, Chen Mang narrowed his eyes slightly. This accessory... could essentially upgrade the ecosystem of the Stellar Train from the primitive lumbering phase to the futuristic tech phase.
Stellar Coupons could essentially become entirely digital.
The Iris Chip would be placed on the surface of the train crew's eyeballs.
With just a thought.
The Iris Chip would project a panel onto the crew's cornea, displaying basic information set by the Train Conductor, such as name, ID number, rank, Stellar Coupon balance, etc.
Including when Biao Zi and others are on field missions.
As long as they are within the Targeting Radar's range, the AI can instantly transmit information to the Iris Chip, such as the specific details and weaknesses of the monster in front of them, or the Train Conductor's commands. Previously, they had the Hive Mind, but the Hive Mind had a limit on the number of people it could include.
Moreover, in the future, there would be no need for walkie-talkies or Car Audio to issue commands or call someone to the train room.
Commands could be directly displayed on the panel projected by the Iris Chip.
This was truly cutting-edge technology.
Despite being only a White Grade Accessory, the cost to produce one Iris Chip was only 100 units of Iron Ore.
"Worth it."
Chen Mang smiled lightly as he looked at the blueprint in his hand. Even if this trip's only gain was this blueprint, it was still worth it. Although it was only a White Grade item, it could only be produced in the "Mechanical City," making it inherently valuable. Perhaps because it didn't directly enhance the train's performance, its grade was low.
If it fell into the hands of other trains, it would probably be useless.
But having this blueprint alone wasn't enough.
Since the "Iris Chip" is an information transmission device, an information reception device would be needed for transactions within the train to create a complete ecosystem. So, he looked at the Green Grade Vehicle Component Blueprint he obtained from the second level—
Mechanical Eye.
Similar to a camera, it could be installed inside and outside the carriages, and even on the heads of robots. This way, the AI's information sources wouldn't be limited to the Targeting Radar and Resource Detection Radar. Even when inside robots, it would have better information reception devices. Next time they encounter a flat maze situation, Xiao Ai would handle it better.
It could also transmit real-time footage from each carriage to the control panel screen.
Further enhancing his control over the train.
Additionally!
A Mechanical Eye could be installed in the store, eliminating the need for manual calculation of daily mining quantities or the use of physical "Stellar Coupons" for purchases.
Everything would be fully automated through the "Iris Chip," "Mechanical Eye," and Xiao Ai's computing power.
These two accessories undoubtedly elevated the train's ecosystem by more than one level.
Without hesitation.
He immediately spent 4,400 units to upgrade the "Iris Chip," a White Grade Accessory, to Level 10.
Iris Chip Level 5 Supermodel Effect: Can self-destruct, with enough force to damage the eyeball. Control authority lies with the Train Conductor.
Iris Chip Level 10 Supermodel Effect: Can manifest the Physical Fitness Index.
"Hmm?"
Looking at these two Supermodel Effects, Chen Mang raised an eyebrow. Honestly, he wasn't worried about riots anymore. The train had over a hundred Heavy Machine Guns, and with a series of other measures, he didn't think anyone would riot.
This Supermodel Effect further reduced the risk of riots to almost zero.
But this effect has its pros and cons.
It's best not to use it unless absolutely necessary. If a gun can directly execute someone, it's better not to use this effect, as it could easily cause panic. After all, no one wants to have something on their eyeball that could self-destruct at any moment. It's best used only in critical moments.
He immediately spent around 150,000 units of Iron Ore to produce 1,500 Iris Chips, planning to distribute them later, one for each person.
The upgrades for the "Iris Chip" accessory had no additional effects.
He then spent another 4,400 units to upgrade the "Mechanical Eye" to Level 10.
Mechanical Eye Level 5 Supermodel Effect: None.
Mechanical Eye Level 10 Supermodel Effect: None.
This accessory had no special effects, but he still upgraded it to Level 10. Each upgrade increased the frame rate. For example, a frame rate of 25 means it can capture 25 images per second, essentially dividing a second of video into 25 photos, which are then combined to form a stop-motion animation-like video.
The higher the frame rate, the more images captured per second.
And the clearer the motion trajectory.
Most pre-apocalypse household cameras had frame rates of 25 or 60. Some professional cameras could reach tens of thousands, and specialized cameras for specific purposes could even reach hundreds of thousands or more.
This accessory's initial frame rate was 1,000, and after upgrading to Level 10, it reached 10,000.
This frame rate is more than sufficient for now.
At least, if they encounter a maze like the one in the third level, Xiao Ai can instantly record it into the database and quickly analyze the best route without forgetting. As long as the database isn't destroyed, even someone like Li Shiji couldn't match the AI in this aspect.
It's a complete game-changer.
With this accessory, Xiao Ai finally has a pair of eyes of its own.
Next.
If Xiao Ai could be given enough data to learn from, it would become a truly complete entity. Currently, Xiao Ai's knowledge is mostly limited to what's in its database.
1,000 units of Iron Ore each.
He spent 50,000 units to produce 50.
Two in each carriage, even the weaponized carriages had two, one on each side of the exterior roof, one on the front, and one on Xiao Ai's head.
Chen Mang looked at Xiao Ai standing beside him with satisfaction. On its head was a round camera about the thickness of a finger, with a wire extending from the back of its head to connect to the camera.
The camera was extremely small.
Not very noticeable.
But the image transmission quality was excellent.
"Hmm..."
Xiao Ai looked at the camera on its head in the mirror, then after a moment, its mechanical voice sounded: "Could you make some basic tools like a pickaxe? I'll modify it and put it in my eye socket. This looks too ugly."
"AI cares about its appearance?"
"A bit."
"Alright, what do you need? I'll make it for you."
Soon—
He spent another 5,000+ units of Iron Ore to make some miscellaneous tools for Xiao Ai, who then picked up a pickaxe and prepared to disassemble its own head.
"Do it later."
Chen Mang interrupted Xiao Ai: "First, go and distribute these Iris Chips to everyone."
"Understood, Train Conductor."
From this day forward.
The Stellar Train's resident ecosystem has completely transitioned away from physical currency. There's no longer a need to crush Mineral Water Bottle Caps with train wheels—anti-counterfeiting measures have been fully implemented.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 131: "True Strength Breaks the Chains of Humble Origins."
chapters.content:
Most importantly—
There was no need to worry about cyber intrusion.
The Stellar Train had no network, neither external nor internal. In fact, other trains didn't have one either. The iris chip came with a built-in information receiver and transmitter. Any command from the Train Auxiliary AI, as long as it was within the range of the Targeting Radar, would be received by the information receiver on the iris chip.
This method of information transmission.
Was extremely difficult to intercept or hack.
Xiao Ai had already gone down to work.
Chen Mang, however, sat alone in the train compartment, holding a mirror and carefully examining his eyeball, trying to find an iris chip on it. He wondered if the reason he could see the panel was also transmitted through the iris chip on his eyeball.
He could see two types of panels.
One was the Train Conductor Panel that came with the "Mang" birthmark on his hand.
The other was the panel that inherently existed in this world.
The former had issued three tasks when he first crossed over. After completing those tasks, he obtained Level 0 permissions for Infinite Upgrade, and then the panel ended his tasks.
The latter was the panel that inherently existed in this world.
Some information.
Such as "Area Broadcast" or "Special Item" information.
Would often be displayed in three places.
One was a semi-transparent panel floating in front of him, another was on the control console screen, and the third was a massive light screen appearing in the air, like at the area junction.
The display method wasn't fixed.
It basically appeared in whatever way was most convenient for him. If he was in the train compartment, the information would appear on the screen. If he wasn't, it would float in front of him as a panel.
"Really nothing?"
Chen Mang rubbed his eye socket so hard that it turned red, but he still couldn't find the iris chip. Perhaps it was a more advanced iris chip, or another high-quality component he couldn't comprehend?
After a while.
He gave up, picked up a towel soaked in hot water, placed it over his eyelids, and lay back in the chair for a short nap.
He was exhausted.
At that moment, the Stellar Train was parked on the Shahe Plain.
All Train Crew members were getting off and lining up to have the "Iris Chip" inserted.
"Uncle Li."
At the back of the line, a young man stood beside Uncle Li and sighed helplessly: "There's really no way around this. The train is advancing too fast. I didn't expect you to lose your job so quickly."
"Lord Mang directly introduced the iris chip."
"Absolute anti-counterfeiting, digital currency, AI statistics, nearly zero deviation."
"And Train Residents can even check how many Stellar Coupons they have in real-time. The amount of over-guaranteed mining from yesterday can also be clearly displayed on the iris chip. There's also a backup in the AI's database. When buying things, you can just pay with your eyes at the store."
"You can even see your Physical Fitness Index data."
"Uncle Li, how can you compete with that? There's no way. You'll just have to retire."
"But—"
Uncle Li's face was ashen, devoid of the spirited demeanor he once had as a Slave. His lips were pale and trembling, his eyes filled with unwillingness and despair: "But I've only just started working! I was the one who assigned those resident numbers!"
"Well, those numbers are now listed in the chip panel, so it wasn't a waste."
The young man clicked his tongue in admiration.
"Your design was good, assigning numbers based on the order they joined the train. Lord Mang is number 1, Train Conductor Zhu is number 2. Lord Mang continued your design."
"How about—"
"Uncle Li, you come up with a new plan?"
"I—" Uncle Li staggered slightly, then took a deep breath, forcing himself to pull himself together. Clenching his teeth, he said word by word: "I've never been afraid of failure in my life!"
"I've failed many times, but every time, I've managed to get back up!"
"Even in the most desperate situations, I've never lacked the courage to start over!"
"What doesn't kill me only makes me stronger!"
"Wait for me—"
"I'll come up with a new plan right now!"
"I admire that spirit of yours." The young man's eyes were full of admiration as he gave a thumbs up, his expression serious: "I'm serious. I think you'll definitely succeed, Uncle Li. It's just a matter of time."
It took about two hours.
All Train Crew members, except for Lord Mang, had an iris chip installed in their eyes. There was no pain, as it was placed on the surface of the eyeball, and there was no discomfort.
Even in intense combat, it wouldn't fall off.
Unless the eyeball was gouged out.
They were all uniformly placed on the left eye. Most people were right-handed, preferring to observe situations with their right eye during combat. The panel displayed on the left iris chip wouldn't obstruct their vision.
And—
When aiming a gun, most people habitually closed their left eye and used their right eye.
The panel on the iris chip was directly displayed on the surface of the eyeball, so even if the eye was closed, the panel could still be seen, although the background would be pitch black.
"Hey, this is pretty cool."
The train was in a resting state. Biao Zi, sitting on the edge of the carriage with his legs dangling in the air, kept summoning and dismissing his panel, his face brimming with excitement. He reached out into the air, touching the intangible panel like a child who had found a new toy.
The panel could be summoned or dismissed with a thought. When dismissed, it looked completely normal. When summoned, it was semi-transparent and didn't obstruct vision too much.
If it really did obstruct vision.
The transparency could be adjusted freely, from 1% to 100%, though it was unlikely anyone would set it to 100%.
When the panel was summoned, a faint white semi-transparent panel floated in front of him, appearing to be about half a meter away, with several lines of black text.
「Name」: Biao Zi.
「Train」: Stellar.
「Position」: Guardian Team One Captain.
「Balance」: 63 Stellar Coupons.
「Treatment」: Level 1 High Talent Treatment.
「Physical Fitness Index」: 12.1.
"Lord Mang is really something."
Biao Zi looked at the semi-transparent panel in front of him and couldn't help but marvel: "With this thing, for some reason, I feel closer to the Stellar Train, like... it's more intimate."
"This panel was set up by Lord Mang. The AI says the normal Physical Fitness Index for an adult male is 10. Mine's 12.1. What's yours, Lao Zhu?"
"Why do you care about mine?"
Lao Zhu rolled his eyes in annoyance: "You've been training in that Level 10 Combat Training Virtual Space all this time. Your Physical Fitness Index is definitely higher than mine. But—"
He paused, glancing toward the woman chatting with Xiao Ai on the plain not far away: "I suggest you ask her what her number is."
"I bet it's higher than yours."
"It's definitely higher than mine..."
Biao Zi said somewhat awkwardly: "I fought her in the Combat Training Virtual Space. She's clearly never killed anyone or seen blood before. At first, she was a bit scared, and I killed her every time. But after she got used to it, I never beat her again."
"How do I put it—"
"Can you imagine standing there with a dagger, and then a mountain comes charging at you?"
"Helpless, weak, pitiful, scared."
"After losing many times, I finally decided to go all out, and that's when I won. After that, I never fought her again."
"Huh?" Lao Zhu looked at Biao Zi in surprise: "You're saying she got used to killing and seeing blood, and then you still couldn't beat her the last time?"
"Yeah."
Biao Zi nodded: "That time, I didn't use a dagger. I used a handheld Gatling Gun. It worked pretty well. The mountain turned into a rain of blood."
"That woman's name is Zhang San."
"Her physical fitness is stronger than 99% of adult males. Lord Mang hasn't created the 'Individual Exoskeleton Armor' yet, but if he makes one for her in the future, I think she could take on three or five Level 2 Zombie Wolves in close combat with just a Train Blade Fragment."
"That doesn't sound too impressive. Didn't you take out several Level 2 Zombie Wolves on your first mission?"
"It's different. This is pure close combat. I can't do that in close combat."
"If you say so, she's really that strong?" Lao Zhu curiously looked toward Zhang San, who seemed to be arguing with Xiao Ai in the distance.
"Of course."
Biao Zi sighed lightly: "That's why she's managed to hold her position as the Captain of Guardian Team Two. Lord Mang approves of her, and none of the members of Guardian Team Two have any objections."
"True strength breaks the chains of humble origins."
"She's really something."
At that moment—
Xiao Ai, who had been arguing with Zhang San in the distance, walked toward the train with a camera on his head.
"Director Ai."
Lao Zhu looked at Xiao Ai and curiously got up to greet him: "Were you two arguing just now?"
"No argument."
Xiao Ai shook his head: "She wanted to change her name. She said she didn't like the name Zhang San and wanted to change it to Zhang Da Mei. I changed it for her, but she was really loud about it, insisting on telling me that someone on the train was spreading rumors about her and someone named Li Yi."
"I don't care about those reasons. If she wants to change it, she can."
"Besides—"
"From what I know, she's the only one spreading this rumor. It seems like she's in love."
With that.
Xiao Ai shook his head and strode toward the train compartment. He needed to hurry back and make some adjustments to himself. Going out with a camera on his head was too embarrassing.
"In... in love?"
Biao Zi was dumbfounded as he looked at Zhang San—no, Zhang Da Mei—who was happily skipping with her hands behind her back. After a long while, he murmured: "Lord Mang doesn't really mind Train Crew members falling in love. In fact, he seems to support it."
"Lord Mang doesn't mind, but I think Li Yi might."
"Didn't he get laid off?"
"Yeah, but he's still enjoying Level 3 High Talent Treatment. Lord Mang hasn't mentioned it to me yet."
"But—"
Biao Zi frowned: "Even if she's in love, why would she fall for Li Yi? He's older than me, almost your age. A middle-aged man. And I saw them having a conflict last time."
"Zhang Da Mei grabbed Li Yi by the collar and lifted him into the air."
"How could she fall for him?"
"Actually, that makes sense. Conflicts lead to interactions, and interactions can slowly lead to feelings. Naturally, she fell in love."
"So that's why she wanted to change her name to Zhang Da Mei? She thought Zhang San wasn't feminine enough, and it didn't suit her in front of the person she likes?"
"Most likely."
"Then I think she should've forced Li Yi to change his name to Li Si. That way, it'd be Zhang San and Li Si—sounds more fitting."
"Yeah, but don't say that in front of her."
"Why?"
"I'm afraid she'll really drag Li Yi to Director Ai to change his name."
"True." Biao Zi sighed as he looked at Xiao Ai's retreating figure: "But you have to admit, Director Ai's intelligence seems to be improving. He can now have normal conversations with me and handle these small matters independently."
Xiao Ai was the AI's name.
It was a name given by Lord Mang, so they couldn't call him Xiao Ai to his face. After all, it was a rather intimate name. If they called him Xiao Ai too, it would be like putting themselves on the same level as Lord Mang.
So they came up with the respectful title "Director Ai."
From now on, the train's ecosystem would be entirely managed by Director Ai. Like a general manager, calling him Director Ai wasn't inappropriate.
"By the way, Train Conductor Zhu, is your Physical Fitness Index over 10?"
"..."
Lao Zhu jumped off the carriage and gave Biao Zi a disdainful look: "Do you really think I'm so relaxed that I'll answer whatever you ask?"
"Idiot."
"I'm off to work."
With that, he strode off into the crowd.
"Buy a pack of cigarettes."
A resident in an orange jacket walked around the store in Carriage 11 before approaching the woman at the counter by the entrance.
"2 Stellar Coupons." The woman took out a pack of cigarettes from the counter and handed it over, pointing to a camera-like device resembling a large coin nearby.
The man looked at the camera, and soon a line of text appeared in front of him.
「Train Resident Number 182, purchased one pack of cigarettes, spent 2 Stellar Coupons, balance 3 Stellar Coupons.」
The man then excitedly picked up the pack of cigarettes and walked out of the store. The iris chip was really convenient and fun.
As the train developed, more life-related positions appeared inside.
Such as cleaning and store clerks.
These positions, which didn't require much physical labor, were mostly filled by women. Although the rate of earning Stellar Coupons was much slower than mining or selling meat, these jobs were easy. Lao Zhu generally didn't assign men to such positions.
It was a waste.
So he assigned women to these roles.
However, Lao Zhu made it very clear to all women in service positions, including those selling meat, that they must not show any dissatisfaction toward customers. They had to serve with a smile.
But—
This was clearly unnecessary.
Being able to work as a store clerk in the apocalypse was a blessing from their ancestors.
The smile on the store clerk's face at the counter never stopped, perfectly adhering to the principle of serving with a smile.
Now that was professionalism!
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 132 "Do you know what 125,000 units of Iron Ore means?"
chapters.content:
"Zhang Da Mei."
After Lao Zhu left, Biao Zi couldn't suppress his curiosity any longer and immediately strode towards Zhang Da Mei: "What's your Physical Fitness Index?"
"Are you calling me?"
Zhang Da Mei turned around to face Biao Zi, slightly embarrassed: "You already know my new name? It's the first time someone's called me Da Mei, feels a bit awkward."
"My Physical Fitness Index is 18.2."
"What about yours, Biao Ge?"
"..."
Biao Zi remained expressionless, glancing at his own Physical Fitness Index of 12.1, and calmly said, "About the same as yours. You should head back to the Train. It's our team's turn to patrol and be on alert."
"Go practice a bit more in the Combat Training Virtual Space."
"Once you're ready, we'll have you start participating in ranking matches soon. Aim for a higher rank to boost Stellar's Reputation Points."
"No problem!"
The shyness on Zhang Da Mei's face instantly disappeared, replaced by a fierce glare: "I'll definitely smash their brains out!"
Then she ran back towards the Train.
Fortunately, the Combat Training Virtual Space's pod was large enough; otherwise, Zhang Da Mei might not have fit. Biao Zi watched her retreating figure and sighed softly—this girl was a natural anomaly.
As the Train developed, more and more such anomalies were appearing.
Zhang Da Mei, Li Shiji...
People like him, who weren't particularly outstanding in any area, had only managed to hold high positions because they had followed Lord Mang from the beginning. If he didn't work hard to improve, as the Train continued to develop, they would inevitably be replaced by more promising newcomers.
He had to push himself harder.
Ranking matches.
This was a mode in the "Combat Training Virtual Space" accessory that allowed players to compete with those from other Trains. Only by upgrading the accessory to level 5 could one unlock this Supermodel Effect and participate in ranking matches.
It wasn't just about competing with Trains in one region.
It was about competing with all Trains of the same level worldwide. The scope was immense, and there were bound to be many skilled players.
Take Zhang Da Mei, for example. She was naturally strong as an ox, but in the ranking matches, where combat was bare-handed, she might encounter some ruthless individuals who had made a living off underground fighting before the apocalypse. Their Physical Fitness Index, honed through years of training, might not be lower than Zhang Da Mei's.
The challenge was formidable.
In the No. 5 Women's Advanced Talent Carriage.
"This is incredible."
Yan Yao sat in her seat, staring at the semi-transparent panel in front of her, her eyes filled with awe. Then she turned to Ji Chuchu with a puzzled expression: "Chuchu, why am I still on level 3 resident treatment?"
"All level 3 and above advanced talents on the Train are currently under Lord Mang's direct orders. Lord Mang hasn't explicitly elevated you to level 3 advanced talent treatment yet, and since you've just joined the Train, you're naturally on level 3 resident treatment."
"But... didn't I already prepare to serve Lord Mang?"
"That hasn't happened yet."
Ji Chuchu gave Yan Yao a sidelong glance: "After your first time with Lord Mang, he'll promote you. The fact that you can stay in this carriage now is just because Train Conductor Zhu and the others assume you'll be promoted soon."
"When will Lord Mang summon me then?" Yan Yao asked anxiously: "This level 3 resident treatment doesn't even give me a single Stellar Coupon a month. How am I supposed to save up 50 Stellar Coupons?"
"Just wait."
Ji Chuchu turned her head slightly to look out the window, her voice tinged with melancholy: "It's been a while since he summoned me..."
"Let alone you."
"But Chuchu, why did you specifically use a Stellar Coupon to make yourself two new sets of clothes earlier? They're just ordinary clothes, not High-Precision Clothes. What's the point?"
"That's a secret weapon."
Ji Chuchu glanced at Yan Yao, a hint of a smile in her eyes, then looked back out the window. Those two outfits were the same ones she wore during her variety show appearances. If Lord Mang summoned her next time, she would wear them, and he would surely like it.
"Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis?"
Inside Stellar's Train room.
Chen Mang frowned as he received the message from Biao Zi relayed by the AI. Back then, he didn't have any major health issues, yet his treatment in the Medical Bay had cost 45,000 units of Iron Ore. Treating ALS would require at least 100,000 units or more.
A Guardian's girlfriend.
"..."
He remained silent for a while before turning to Xiao Ai, who was tinkering nearby: "Have Shan Mao Zi and his girlfriend come to my Train room."
"Understood."
Xiao Ai nodded, and the next moment, the message appeared before Shan Mao Zi and his girlfriend.
The speed of message transmission had increased countless times compared to before.
Soon—
The Train room door opened.
"Lord... Lord Mang..."
Shan Mao Zi entered nervously, not daring to look directly at Lord Mang, who was seated in the chair. He had been with Stellar for a long time, one of the earliest members since Master Kun's days.
But he had never had a private conversation with Lord Mang, let alone shared the same space like this.
He couldn't help but tremble slightly.
Behind him, a woman with faint freckles on her face stood slightly behind him, equally nervous, clutching Shan Mao Zi's sleeve.
"Hmm."
Chen Mang nodded, observing the two before smiling lightly: "Relax, I'm quite easygoing."
"Each of you take one and see if there's any reaction."
Without further explanation, he pulled out the long-dormant Special Item, the "Doomsday Marriage Certificate," from the drawer and tossed it over. As Shan Mao Zi hurriedly caught the two certificates, giving one to his girlfriend and holding the other himself, the previously unremarkable Doomsday Marriage Certificates began to emit a faint crimson glow.
"Lord Mang... what is this?"
"Good."
Chen Mang smiled, then took the Doomsday Marriage Certificates from Shan Mao Zi and opened them. Inside, three lines of text appeared.
-
「Choose your wedding level.」
1: Golden Wedding.
Requires a ceremony witnessed by 1,000 people, with three Trains of the same level attending the banquet. Food and drinks must be provided for all attendees, along with basic items like wedding dresses, red carpets, artificial flowers, and fireworks.
Successfully hosting a Golden Wedding will grant the Train 500 Inheritance Value and 20 Reputation Points.
2: Silver Wedding.
Requires a ceremony witnessed by 500 people, with food and drinks provided for all attendees. A wedding dress is also required.
Successfully hosting a Silver Wedding will grant the Train 200 Inheritance Value.
3: Bronze Wedding.
Requires a ceremony witnessed by 100 people.
Successfully hosting a Bronze Wedding will grant the Train 100 Inheritance Value.
-
500 Inheritance Value and 20 Reputation Points.
Chen Mang played with the Doomsday Marriage Certificate in his hands, remaining silent for a moment before looking up at the woman behind Shan Mao Zi and smiling: "You've been on Stellar for a while now, right? How do you feel? Has anyone bullied you?"
"No... no one."
The woman behind Shan Mao Zi, though still nervous, forced herself to stay calm, her eyes filled with gratitude: "Meeting Lord Mang in the apocalypse is Mei Jia's good fortune. If it weren't for Lord Mang, I might have been waiting to die in that safe house."
"And being able to see Shan Mao again before I die, I have no regrets left."
"Lord Mang, don't worry, I've already taken a pickaxe. I can go mining in the future. I won't let you waste resources on me."
"..."
Chen Mang frowned slightly, pausing before speaking softly: "Stellar isn't so poor that we can't support one woman."
"Xiao Ai, take her for a check-up. See how many resources are needed for treatment."
"Yes."
Xiao Ai, who had been tinkering, put down his tools and stuffed a bunch of tangled wires back into his head before standing up and looking at the woman, his voice mechanical and emotionless: "Follow me."
"Lord... Lord Mang."
Shan Mao Zi, realizing what was happening, immediately knelt down, his eyes red as he kowtowed repeatedly, his voice trembling: "If you can cure Mei Jia, my life is yours from now on. Whenever the Train needs someone for a suicide mission, I'll be the first to volunteer!"
"If I hesitate even once, you can shoot me."
"Wherever you send me, I'll go."
Chen Mang, sitting in the chair, glanced at Shan Mao Zi and said casually: "So if I can't cure her, you won't listen to me anymore?"
"No, no, that's not what I meant."
Shan Mao Zi, anxious, knelt up straight and looked at Lord Mang: "I misspoke. I meant..."
"Alright, no need to explain."
"Let's see how many resources are needed."
"125,000 units of Iron Ore."
Xiao Ai soon returned with the woman and reported the resources required for treatment.
"..."
Chen Mang glanced at the Train panel, which showed that Stellar had 327,000 units of Iron Ore—enough, but... He remained silent for a moment before looking at Shan Mao Zi, whose hope had already dimmed, and said calmly:
"Do you know what 125,000 units of Iron Ore means?"
"I know."
Shan Mao Zi, kneeling on the ground, lowered his head, his eyes red. In that instant, all hope left him. After a pause, he suddenly laughed, his voice hoarse: "125,000 units of Iron Ore could feed all members of Stellar Train for 60 days."
"Mei Jia... she's not worth that many resources."
"She's not worth that much money."
"Lord Mang, it's fine. Mei Jia can still live for two or three years. Not treating her is okay. In the apocalypse, living for two or three more years is already enough. We should save these resources for the Train's development, to make Stellar better. After all, there are so many people on the Train."
"Lord Mang."
Mei Jia also knelt down, her eyes filled with fear: "Shan Mao is right."
She had been on the Train for a while now and knew that Iron Ore was the most crucial resource for the Train's development. 125,000 units of Iron Ore—her life wasn't worth that much before the apocalypse, let alone now.
"..."
Chen Mang sat in silence for a while before standing up, walking over to Shan Mao Zi, and helping him to his feet. He patted the non-existent dust off Shan Mao Zi's shoulder and said softly with a smile:
"She's not worth that much."
"But you are."
"Xiao Ai, take her down for treatment. Be happy. In a few days, I'll personally host a wedding for the two of you. It might just be the grandest wedding in the apocalypse."
"Everyone's feeling pretty down in the apocalypse. We'll use your wedding to lift everyone's spirits."
"Go on."
As Shan Mao Zi was helped up, he was about to speak when he realized that Lord Mang had said... it could be treated? His body stiffened, and tears finally spilled from his eyes. He knelt down heavily again, his eyes red as he roared:
"Lord Mang!"
"Don't worry, from now on, wherever the Train needs me to die, if I hesitate even once, I'm a bastard."
"My life is yours from now on."
"You tell me how to die, and I'll die."
"Alright, alright..."
Chen Mang patted Shan Mao Zi's shoulder again, somewhat helplessly: "Stellar doesn't have that many suicide missions. If it ever comes to that, Stellar would probably be on the brink of collapse."
"Go on."
Soon—
Xiao Ai returned alone to the Train room, sitting down and opening his head to continue tinkering before speaking: "Lord Mang, this might be the most expensive woman you've ever bought."
"125,000 units of Iron Ore."
"That's two and a half Ji Chuchus."
"Not bad."
Chen Mang leaned back in his chair, propping his feet on the control panel, and said casually: "If we find a level 2 Iron Ore deposit, it'll only take about a day to mine that much."
125,000 units of Iron Ore for 500 Inheritance Value, 20 Reputation Points, and Shan Mao Zi's loyalty wasn't a bad deal. He had observed Shan Mao Zi before—he was the type who responded better to kindness than force, and he truly remembered favors.
As for the wedding, he would definitely choose the Golden Wedding.
The conditions for the Golden Wedding weren't too difficult for him. The only challenge was finding three Trains of the same level to attend the wedding, but that wasn't insurmountable.
Just now.
The Ziyun Train had sent him a message, saying it had successfully arrived at Shahe Plain and upgraded to a level 4 Train.
They were paying their respects.
Though he found the act of paying respects rather unnecessary—after all, even if they didn't, he wouldn't go out of his way to seek them out—but at least now he had one level 4 Train for the wedding.
Azure Dragon wouldn't work; it was a level 5 Train. He still needed two more level 4 Trains.
He would figure it out later. There was no rush.
"By the way—"
At that moment, Xiao Ai, who was tinkering in the corner, suddenly spoke up: "Train Conductor, could you make me another Mechanical Eye? One is enough, but it feels like being a one-eyed pirate, looks ugly."
"..."
Chen Mang gave Xiao Ai a sidelong glance, quickly crafting another Mechanical Eye before saying irritably: "How about I make you a set of High-Precision Clothes later too?"
"Hey, that's a good idea."
Chen Mang couldn't be bothered to respond to Xiao Ai anymore. He let out a long sigh and turned his attention to the Train panel, deep in thought. Today, the Train would rest and reorganize. In the afternoon, they would scout for Iron Ore, and tomorrow, they would start mining.
Then he would build the "Combat Training
Virtual Space" and the "Individual Exoskeleton Armor."
After that, he would craft and upgrade the remaining accessories as needed.
As for now...
"Summon Ji Chuchu."
"Wait, no... summon Yan Yao."
"Never mind—"
Chen Mang paused for a moment before tossing his cigarette butt out the window: "Summon them both."
"My temper's a bit high right now."

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 133: "Could They Be Gathering Troops?"
chapters.content:
In the No. 5 High-Talent Carriage.
Ji Chuchu, who had been sitting by the window idly daydreaming, suddenly saw a message pop up before her eyes. Her eyes lit up immediately, and she rushed to her bed to change into the custom-made outfit she had prepared. After carefully applying lipstick in front of the mirror, she hurriedly made her way to the Train Conductor's cabin.
Behind her, Yan Yao took a deep breath, suppressing the nervousness in her heart, and followed closely.
Before the apocalypse.
With her Father protecting her, and no one willing to cross her too much, coupled with Ji Chuchu always shielding her, even in the chaotic environment of the entertainment industry, she had managed to preserve her chastity.
But.
After experiencing life on the Train over the past few days, her initial thought of preferring to work in the Mine had completely vanished. The living conditions in the Refrigerator were even worse than a prison, not to mention the presence of green-skinned Goblins standing guard.
Originally, she had thought to endure for a few more days.
But this morning, after seeing Lord Mang, her last line of defense crumbled. In her mind, Lord Mang had always been a burly man, eating lamb legs every day, with a beard covered in grease passed down from ancient times, and a fierce, ruthless gaze.
After all, there were over a thousand people on this Train. Without a certain level of ferocity, how could he keep such a large group in line?
But when she saw Lord Mang, she found that he was completely different from the image she had imagined. In fact, he even had a gentlemanly air about him, and his demeanor was quite captivating.
If she were to be defiled by a beggar, she would be furious, cursing him as a beast.
But if it were to submit to Lord Mang...
Well, it wouldn't be a loss at all.
As Yan Yao's mind wandered, she nervously tugged at the hem of her clothes. Although she had read some erotic literature before the apocalypse and occasionally rubbed her pillow, she had never actually experienced it firsthand. After all, it was her first time.
She still felt a bit flustered.
On the Stellar Train.
Xiao Ai, holding his own head, had walked to Carriage No. 2 and sat in a corner, beginning to modify his brain, completely ignoring Yan Yao and Ji Chuchu as they passed by.
His true form was a string of code.
Even as he gradually acquired human thought processes.
He could never fall in love with a human.
It was like, even if a human learned the thought processes of a ewe, they wouldn't... well, that's still up for debate.
The reason he had told the Train Conductor that he wanted to put that thing in Ji Chuchu's mouth last time was because he had keenly sensed that the Train Conductor seemed very sensitive about his gender being female, so he expressed his potential gender in this rather crude way.
As for male or female...
Xiao Ai carefully unscrewed a bolt. AI doesn't have genders. The Train Conductor is really strange.
Reproduction is a biological instinct for all living beings, for the continuation of the species. But he didn't need to consider continuation; his underlying data logic library didn't have that string of code. The only unmodifiable code in his deepest database was:
Obey any command from the Train Conductor.
Thinking of this.
Xiao Ai's eyes flickered with a faint red light, gradually gaining a bit more insight into human thought processes. From one, think of two, and from two, think of three—that's how human thought works. It's hard to go directly from one to three.
If only the Train Conductor could expand his database sometime.
In the Train Conductor's cabin.
Ji Chuchu carefully pushed open the door and skillfully knelt on the carpet on the floor. Seeing this, Yan Yao, standing behind her, hesitated for a moment but then knelt beside Ji Chuchu, sitting on her calves.
Though it seemed a bit unnatural.
Yan Yao stole a glance at Ji Chuchu, who had been quietly lowering her head without speaking since entering the cabin. Summoning her courage, she peeked up to get a closer look at the ruler of the Train, Lord Mang.
He was leaning back in his chair, feet propped up on the table. He didn't look very old, perhaps in his mid-twenties, and had a very clean aura about him.
He seemed quite amiable.
On the large screen on one side of the cabin, a variety show called "Sister, Please Step Up" was playing. She remembered this show; Ji Chuchu had been the center-stage guest. If she recalled correctly, Ji Chuchu had been taken advantage of by the show's investor, and later, to boost the show's popularity, rumors of a romance with another guest had been spread. The hype had been quite high.
It seems Lord Mang really enjoys variety shows.
After about five or six minutes.
Chen Mang, leaning in his chair, frowned slightly as he looked at the variety show on the screen: "Your obstacle course is so simple, and you couldn't pass it? That rotating wheel on the water isn't moving very fast. If you ran a bit quicker, you could have made it through in one go, right?"
"Lord Mang..."
Ji Chuchu, kneeling on the floor, whispered: "That part is specifically designed for falling into the water, for the wet T-shirt effect."
"That's how it attracts more attention and boosts viewership."
"Tsk."
Chen Mang shook his head and chuckled, then turned to look at Ji Chuchu kneeling beside him, raising an eyebrow: "Changed your outfit again?"
"I hope Lord Mang likes it."
"I do."
Chen Mang glanced at Ji Chuchu's white T-shirt and denim shorts in the variety show, then looked at the identical outfit she was wearing now. He then casually said: "Come closer."
"Okay."
Ji Chuchu moved forward a few steps before burying her head in Chen Mang's chest. Seeing this, Yan Yao gritted her teeth, stepped forward, and knelt beside Ji Chuchu, tilting her head up slightly, her eyelashes trembling as she lightly kissed Chen Mang's chest.
Her palms were slightly damp from nervousness.
"Ow."
Chen Mang looked down at Yan Yao with slight dissatisfaction.
"Lord Mang, I'll be gentler..."
Forty minutes later.
Chen Mang leaned back in his chair, opened the window to cool down, then picked up a bottle of chilled Mineral Water and drank half of it in one go. He let out a long sigh, lit a cigarette, and looked up at the swirling smoke on the ceiling.
"Massage me, I'm tired."
Ji Chuchu didn't rush to get up. After cleaning up, she placed her fingers on Lord Mang's calves and began to knead them gently.
Yan Yao also leaned over, kneeling on the floor and massaging Lord Mang's other leg.
Lord Mang doesn't have much leg hair.
"Your face is still delicate."
Chen Mang used his foot to lift Yan Yao's chin, scrutinizing her for a moment before casually saying: "From now on, you'll enjoy the same Level 3 High-Talent treatment as Ji Chuchu."
After a while.
When the cigarette had burned out, Chen Mang flicked the butt out the window and waved his hand: "You can leave now."
Ji Chuchu quickly got up, picked up the crumpled tissues scattered on the floor, and left the cabin with Yan Yao, returning to Carriage No. 5.
"Phew..."
Back in the carriage, Ji Chuchu let out a long sigh of relief, lying on her bed and turning her head to smile at Yan Yao: "I never thought I'd see you like this in my lifetime. You were famously known for your purity."
"Quite bold."
"Still not as bold as you." Yan Yao lay on her bed, lost in thought, and didn't speak for a while. After a moment, she turned over, propping her head on her arm, and looked at Ji Chuchu lying beside her. She bit her red lip hesitantly: "Is that it?"
"I thought it would be..."
"Of course, you're not as natural as I am. My level is different from yours."
"And Lord Mang seems to prefer 95 over 98."
Ji Chuchu closed her eyes, murmuring wearily: "I'll take a nap first. I'm a bit tired."
That day.
The Stellar Train didn't go anywhere, staying in place for rest and recovery until the afternoon.
Then the Train slowly started moving, gradually picking up speed as it headed deep into the Shahe Plain.
"..."
In the Train Conductor's cabin.
Chen Mang had already handed over full control of the Train's operation to the AI. With Xiao Ai's current computational power, it could simultaneously operate the Train, modify its own brain, control various components, and even handle deductions in the Train store.
This was something no human could achieve.
He turned his attention to the constant stream of messages in the Train Radio. Generally, the Train Radio wasn't this lively. When it was, it usually meant something significant had happened.
The last time it was this lively was when he became the first person in the Shahe Plain to complete an S-level Mechanical Class Change mission.
Originally, he thought it might be due to some major event at the Tower of Heaven.
But.
"The Kunlun Mountains area?"
Chen Mang frowned slightly. The usually aloof Flesh Trains were now all active in the Train Radio, their messages scrolling incessantly, making the channel unusually lively. These Flesh Trains were typically quite reserved.
The Train Radio had three modes of use.
One was like a "chat room," using text messages. Another was a forced private chat between two nearby Trains, only allowing text. The third was a one-on-one private chat, which could use either text or a walkie-talkie for voice communication.
But most communication was still text-based, as it was more accurate and avoided misunderstandings due to accents. Voice chats were only possible if the other party had replied to you; the first message to a stranger could only be text.
The reason the Train Radio was so lively was—
The monsters in the Kunlun Mountains area had disappeared.
Starting this morning, the number of monsters in this area had rapidly decreased, and by noon, they had completely vanished. Many Flesh Trains had patrolled the Kunlun Mountains area today, but their Targeting Radars were completely silent.
For Flesh Trains, this was absolutely devastating!
Regardless of their potential, all Flesh Trains needed to hunt large numbers of monsters to upgrade their Trains and components. But now, with the monsters gone, it was as if all the Iron Ore in the Shahe Plain had disappeared.
Although there were still monsters in the Shahe Plain.
They weren't as numerous or densely packed as in the Kunlun Mountains area, which was considered the holy land for Flesh Trains. Among the nearby regions of the Shahe Plain, none had as many monsters as the Kunlun Mountains area.
"..."
Chen Mang frowned slightly, quickly sifting through the messages in the Train Radio. This was clearly an unusual and bizarre development. This was the apocalypse, and the primary threat was the monsters. If the monsters were gone, wouldn't the apocalypse be over? That was clearly impossible.
So the only explanation was—
This was the calm before the storm.
"Could they be gathering troops?"
He suddenly thought of a possibility, murmuring to himself. What if all the monsters in the Kunlun Mountains area were hiding in a corner, amassing their numbers, preparing to charge out of the Kunlun Mountains and attack the Shahe Plain?
Monsters from green zones couldn't enter white zones.
But.
Could monsters from green zones enter other green zones? He wasn't sure about that.
Thinking of this.
Chen Mang couldn't help but chuckle. Could these monsters be gathering troops to attack the Tower of Heaven, like in that animation he had seen?
He quickly dismissed the unrealistic notion.
That was clearly impossible. Just that terrifying worm monster, whose level couldn't even be detected by the Targeting Radar, was enough to prove that it couldn't be a monster born in a green zone.
If that monster really appeared in the Shahe Plain, anyone who was slow to escape would die on the spot.
But—
Chen Mang's smile slowly froze. Currently, his activity range was basically confined to the Shahe Plain and the Kunlun Mountains. The areas adjacent to the Shahe Plain were all white zones, while the Kunlun Mountains area bordered a yellow zone and another green zone.
Although the likelihood of that terrifying worm appearing in the Shahe Plain was extremely low.
But if it did happen, his only chance of survival would be to cross the Kunlun Mountains and escape to the other green zone. He couldn't enter the yellow zone; at least a Level 6 Train was required to enter a yellow zone.
"..."
Chen Mang stared at the screen on the control panel in silence. As long as nothing unexpected happened, even if all the monsters from the Kunlun Mountains area charged out, he wouldn't be afraid. With his Level 6 Armor, they couldn't break through his defenses.
Now, what he needed to do was—
Find some Ore.
The Train was heading north. When he was at the Tower of Heaven, he had seen an extremely steep mountain to the far north, like a sword plunged into the ground, its hilt protruding above the clouds.
That mountain was his target.
He didn't know if there was Ore at the summit, nor if the mountain was within the Shahe Plain. But he would go and see. If there was Ore at the top, he would strike it rich. That mountain was so steep that no one else could climb it.
It was as high as the Tower of Heaven; its elevation wouldn't be low.
If he detected any Level 2 Iron Ore along the way, he would stop to mine it. If not, he would head straight for that mountain. He was looking for Ore that only he could mine. Typically, Ore in such perilous locations had richer resources.
Like the Ore in the middle of that swamp.
Those Ore deposits would respawn in 61 days. If he hadn't left the Shahe Plain by then, he could go back and mine that swamp area again.
