chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 150: "No way, how can the train play like this?!"
chapters.content:
Chen Mang immediately spotted the train racing through the blizzard high above—it was Er Dan's Azure Dragon.
"I'll give it a try."
He glanced at his copper ore balance, which stood at 825,000 units, while the cost to craft a level 6 missile was 300,000 units of copper ore.
"Ha."
Chen Mang took a deep breath, not thinking too much about it. He had to try to know if it would work, and that zombie had been roaring incessantly. If he could accurately stuff the missile into its mouth and make it explode inside its body, the power would be greatly enhanced.
One missile probably wouldn't be enough; he needed two.
Before long.
After consuming 300,000 units of copper ore, a level 6 ground burst missile was crafted.
"Shh shh shh."
Accompanied by the sound of mechanical gears turning, a pitch-black missile slowly rose from the 14th carriage, angled toward the sky, ready to launch at any moment.
"Can it shoot into its mouth?"
Chen Mang turned his head to Xiao Ai beside him and said in a low voice.
"Yes."
Xiao Ai's voice was devoid of emotion, but the response was crisp and clear.
The hydraulic supports on the 14th open-air carriage held the missile like vertebrae, and with a roar, a deep blue tail flame erupted from the hexagonal nozzle at the missile's rear, instantly raising the temperature around the train to a peak.
The missile launched from the train, piercing through the air, aimed directly at the massive zombie caught in the blizzard.
The trailing tail flame cut through the storm, captivating like Satan's brush dipped in pus and blood, tearing through the night sky.
Then, under Chen Mang's unwavering gaze, the missile followed an extremely standard and graceful trajectory, accurately hitting the zombie's mouth, plunging straight in like a deep throat.
Perhaps due to the size of its throat, such a large foreign object entered without any visible signs of the throat expanding.
The next moment—
"Boom!!!"
The deafening explosion echoed through the heavens and earth, sounding even more muffled than the last missile explosion. The compressed explosives contained within the missile detonated at the zombie's throat.
In an instant.
The zombie's head was blown off into the sky.
Its neck snapped on the spot.
Countless orange flames erupted from the severed neck.
Three seconds later.
The headless zombie, still in a frenzy, seemed to finally react, its body crashing heavily to the ground, sending a large amount of blood-stained snow flying into the air, creating a striking scene.
"..."
Chen Mang glanced at the data stream continuously fluctuating on the control panel screen, which was the AI calculating the missile's trajectory, then looked toward the headless zombie lying in the snow, chuckling softly.
"You don't need to display these things; I can't understand them anyway."
"I'm afraid you wouldn't know how hard I work if I don't show them."
The zombie lay in the snow, unable to rise again, with a torrent of rich blood gushing from its neck wound, staining the snow.
The combination of blood and white snow was truly fitting.
The blood-stained snow resembled wrapping roasted meat in lettuce while eating, both refreshing and satisfying, lacking the bloody feeling brought by the blood, yet adding a unique coolness from the snow.
He had initially thought he might need two level 6 missiles.
After all, this zombie was indeed the largest he had ever seen among all the monsters, but unexpectedly, just one missile successfully hitting its mouth caused it to collapse completely.
On the targeting radar, the red dot gradually faded away, signifying that the zombie had no chance of survival.
The next moment—
The words on the light screen at the junction of the two areas also changed.
-
"The area ahead is a green zone, Ice and Snow World."
"Up to level 6 monsters can exist here, and the current train level is 5, with a low danger coefficient. Please pay attention to safety."
-
The lockdown was lifted!
At that moment, the Azure Dragon train, which had been racing through the air, suddenly sped toward the Stellar Train, and Er Dan's excited roar came through the intercom.
"Wait a minute."
Chen Mang smiled and shook his head, immediately controlling the Stellar Train to enter the area ahead. As they got closer, the Powerful Magnet had already drawn in the loot from the zombie's death.
No other trains were nearby.
There was no need to worry about someone snatching his loot; even if someone wanted to, they couldn't outpace him.
Naturally, Er Dan wouldn't snatch it. If he were that kind of person, Chen Mang wouldn't have come to rescue him.
At that moment—
The Azure Dragon train made a sharp turn and landed beside him. Er Dan, wearing a military coat, jumped down from the train compartment, standing in the snow and shouting toward the Stellar Train's compartment, "Bro, come down for a chat!"
With each word, a large amount of warm breath shot out into the cold air.
"Eh?"
Er Dan suddenly noticed that he couldn't see the interior of the Stellar Train through the glass and couldn't help but express disbelief, "Bro, you didn't upgrade that yellow-grade 'Dust-Free Glass' to level 5, did you?"
"Not long ago, a Train Conductor was crying on the train radio, saying he thought the level 5 Supermodel Effect would have something good, but it turned out to be just a one-way window Supermodel Effect, wasting so much iron ore."
As he finished speaking.
Chen Mang pushed open the train compartment and jumped down, leaning on his cane as he stepped into the snow beside Er Dan. He took out two cigarettes from his pocket, lit one for himself, and handed the other to Er Dan. After exhaling a long breath, he looked toward the massive zombie lying in the snow and sighed.
"Bro, when the apocalypse came, did you ever calculate your fortune?"
"This area was fine before; why did so many things happen when you arrived?"
"Hey."
Er Dan said somewhat awkwardly, "I can't take all the blame for this. It's a long story, and I'll tell you slowly later, but bro, I really envy you. S-class potential is just great."
"While level 6 trains are still using automatic cannons, you, with a level 5 train, have already produced missiles."
"That's a serious downgrade."
"Too bad I haven't seen what the large firepower components of the A-class train 'World Weary Train' on Shahe Plain are, but they definitely can't compare to yours."
He then looked at Chen Mang with a serious expression.
"Thanks, bro. If you hadn't come, I would have probably been worn out in this area."
"How much copper ore did that missile use? I'll reimburse you."
Chen Mang glanced at Er Dan and casually replied, "300,000 units of copper ore."
"..."
After a moment of silence, Er Dan continued, "Whether to reimburse or not, we'll talk about that later. I've run out of copper ore in my train. Bro, I remember your kindness. If you ever need me, just say the word."
"As long as it's not a matter of going to my death, I'll come right away."
"I thought you would say you'd face mountains of knives and seas of fire without hesitation."
"That would be a bit fake; after all, who isn't afraid of death?"
"But..."
Er Dan tightened his military coat, looking at Chen Mang, who was dressed so lightly, with a hint of confusion in his eyes, "Aren't you cold wearing so little in this weather?"
"Not really."
Chen Mang patted Er Dan's shoulder and smiled, "The clothing customization production line has been upgraded to level 10, with a temperature lock effect. Standing here for a while isn't too cold. What about you? Didn't you upgrade to level 10? This Supermodel Effect is quite useful."
"..."
Er Dan's mouth twitched slightly, and he didn't speak. Even if he suddenly had a thousand Murphy Stones, he wouldn't spend eight of them on the 'clothing customization production line' for that temperature lock effect; he'd rather wear a bit more!
"Alright."
Chen Mang pointed to the massive headless zombie not far away, "We'll chat later; I have some business to attend to. I need to cut this zombie up and collect it before it freezes."
"Wait." Er Dan looked at the zombie in confusion, "Bro, you're not a Flesh Train; what do you need this for?"
"Just keep it for now; it might come in handy later. After all, such a large zombie is hard to find, and if we trade with the Flesh Train in the future, it could be useful."
"No, bro, when you kill zombies, don't they drop 'corpse meat'? That kind of blood meat material with units is the key to upgrading the Flesh Train. Although the Flesh Train does consume this meat as snacks, it doesn't need this much!"
"Is that so?"
Chen Mang silently gazed at the headless zombie in the distance. He had always thought the Flesh Train upgraded directly with blood meat. He had collected quite a bit over the past few days, but after pausing for a moment, he still walked toward the train compartment, "Let's collect it first; it might be useful."
Ten minutes later.
Chen Mang crafted thirty ordinary carriages, each equipped with ten-meter-wide level 50 car blades. The entire Stellar Train, like a python, coiled around the massive zombie, continuously rotating and drilling up from the ground, directly emerging from beneath the zombie.
Before long, it was dismembered into pieces.
The car blades, forcibly removed from the carriages, shattered instantly into glimmering shards.
All the car blades from the thirty ordinary carriages were forcibly removed, shattering into countless fragments.
Then, a group of train residents disembarked, picking up the shards on the ground, wrapping a corner in rags, and began to carefully cut the large chunks of blood meat from the massive zombie, as long as they didn't exceed the size of the refrigerator door.
Anything that met the size requirement would be instantly drawn into the train's refrigerator by the Powerful Magnet.
After a monster dies, its defenses drop significantly, making it not very difficult to cut. It was even a bit easier than cutting that level 3 Man-Eating Spider back then.
Speaking of which.
He had killed quite a few monsters, but that level 3 Man-Eating Spider was probably the one that died the most miserably at his hands, being slowly tortured to death.
He then controlled the Stellar Train to activate the Geothermal Furnace, turning the train head into a massive mouth filled with countless rotating gears, devouring all thirty ordinary carriages that had already separated from the train.
Afterward—
Chen Mang jumped down from the train compartment, walked over to Er Dan, and leaned on his cane, smiling, "Sorry for the show. I've been through tough times, and I thought it was rare to see such a large zombie for the first time. Collecting it might come in handy someday."
"By the way."
He turned his head and waved to Lao Zhu, "Find some people to dig up some of this snow; don't get it dirty. Look for the clean stuff and freeze it in the refrigerator; it might be useful later."
"Yes." Lao Zhu nodded seriously and then strode away.
"..."
Standing beside him, Er Dan was already dumbfounded. After sniffing, he looked at Chen Mang with disbelief, "Bro, have you always played like this?"
"How come, as fellow Train Conductors, I feel like our train operations are completely different?"
"No way, how can the train play like this?!"
"Not too bad." Chen Mang chuckled, "Actually, it's nothing."
"Ha."
Er Dan took a deep breath and tightened his military coat again, his expression complex, "Having more refrigerators is great."
Even if he wanted to stuff these things into his train, he couldn't fit them. He did have a yellow-grade 'Space Gate' that was similar to Chen Mang's level 10 refrigerator, but he wouldn't dare fill such a precious space with zombie blood meat.
A level 5 'Space Gate' wasn't cheap.
He couldn't afford to spend that money.
The main issue wasn't about affording it; it was that this thing was useless! What good would stuffing so much zombie blood meat into the train do?!
The Flesh Train wouldn't want it either!!
He now fully believed that Chen Mang had absolutely started from scratch, with no big shots backing him. Only someone who started from nothing would develop such a character; those who had big shots supporting them wouldn't care about these things.
"Wait, I'll send you a few refrigerators; these things are quite useful. You can take a few."
"Don't."
Er Dan shook his head seriously, "That's not appropriate. You came all this way to save me and consumed so much of your copper ore. I haven't repaid your kindness yet; if you give me refrigerators, won't I be taking advantage of you?"
"But..."
Er Dan paused for a moment, then seemed a bit tempted, "How about I trade you something for a bit? I got two boxes of cigarettes a while ago, each containing 250 cigarettes. I'll give you one box in exchange for two refrigerators; how about that?"
Chen Mang raised an eyebrow, slung an arm around Er Dan's shoulder, and smiled, "How about I give you six refrigerators in exchange for two boxes of cigarettes? Just keep 50 cigarettes for yourself from those two boxes; after all, you won't give those slaves any to smoke, and you and your management staff won't need that many, right?"
"Deal!"
Er Dan almost immediately jumped in to agree as soon as Chen Mang finished speaking, as if afraid Chen Mang would change his mind. Then he couldn't help but grin, "Thanks, bro."
"These six refrigerators will be a huge help for me."
"By the way, bro."
He suddenly thought of something and said seriously, "Although there are storage boxes and the Space Gate, which can maximize the utilization of train space, there are many times when the function of a level 10 refrigerator cannot be replaced. Have you ever thought about selling some refrigerators at the assembly?"
"Sell?"
Chen Mang shook his head, "Refrigerators are white-grade components, and upgrading to a level 10 refrigerator requires at least eight Murphy Stones. You do the math; how much should I sell them for?"
"Of course, I've thought about selling them, but I didn't plan to sell them in the green zone."
"They can't afford the price."
"I'll sell them when I get to the yellow zone."

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 151 "Sprinkle Some Water, Make an Ice Tomb"
chapters.content:
"True."
Er Dan nodded in agreement. Although he didn't understand why Chen Mang was willing to spend so many Murphy Stones on a Refrigerator, upgrading one to level 10 indeed required 8 Murphy Stones. How could he sell that?
It was like slapping a Quadruple Holographic Titan onto an underground water Tec-9.
The price was definitely high.
But it was far from fetching the price of selling the Murphy Stones individually. Selling in the green zone was really not cost-effective; he couldn't afford such a high price.
As for being able to exchange it for two boxes of cigarettes, that was purely because of his acquaintance with Chen Mang.
Speaking of which, he sometimes really admired himself.
Back then, he actually had some conflicts with Chen Mang. Chen Mang's maze had tortured him for a full half hour. In such a situation, most people would have sought revenge, yet he managed to maintain a good relationship with Chen Mang.
This kind of ability wasn't something everyone had.
Having an enemy like Chen Mang would make it hard to sleep at night.
But having a friend like Chen Mang made sleeping much more peaceful.
It's always better to have more friends than enemies.
"Alright."
Chen Mang changed the subject: "Let's not talk about that. Tell me, how did this happen?"
"That's a long story."
Er Dan took a deep breath, glanced around, and then said helplessly, "Can we talk in your train? It's really cold outside."
"You're not cold."
"But I really am. Look, my nose is running. If I catch a cold, it'll just waste resources."
He definitely wouldn't invite Chen Mang to his own train; that would be too presumptuous. In this post-apocalyptic environment, inviting another Train Conductor to your train was almost like sleeping with his wife in front of him—without some deaths, it wouldn't feel right.
But going to Chen Mang's train was fine.
He wasn't afraid.
Not far away, a crowd was still dismembering that Zombie in the snow.
In the 6th male advanced talent car.
"Hoo."
Sitting in his seat, Er Dan took a cup of hot water from Xiao Fang, glanced up at the 10 Heavy Machine Guns pointed inward from the ceiling, twitched his mouth slightly, and took a deep breath.
It was just like the time in the maze.
The car with the maze also had 10 Heavy Machine Guns pointed inward.
It was the same feeling.
Er Dan sipped the hot water, organized his thoughts, and then continued, "At first, I got some intel that in the 'Ice and Snow World' green zone, a big mountain had a landslide due to a blizzard or avalanche, causing a part of the mountain to collapse."
"Revealing a huge arm."
"That mountain was thousands of meters high. No train in this area could go up there, but my train can fly, so I thought I'd come and take a look. Maybe I'd find another Fortuitous Encounter map or something."
"When I arrived and saw that huge arm, I was truly shocked."
"Most importantly—"
"The Targeting Radar told me this Zombie was actually alive!"
"Imagine, such a big boss, sealed here, and still alive, not resisting. Killing this boss now would be a huge gain, right?"
"But the arm isn't a fatal part, so I used a Drill Bit to go deep into the mountain, trying to find the Zombie's head."
"I don't know if it was because of me, but the Zombie suddenly broke free, and then..."
"It turned into what you see now."
Er Dan sighed deeply and then said somewhat helplessly, "I almost died in this area, but it wasn't a total loss. I saved over 300 people, including dozens of children, gained over thirty points of Inheritance Value, and got more than 200 Slaves. Not bad."
"Children?"
Chen Mang frowned slightly.
"Yeah."
Er Dan nodded: "They're all around ten years old. This is the first time I've seen children in the apocalypse. They're all very well-behaved, not at all like the mischievous kids you'd expect. The apocalypse makes people grow up too fast; they all seem very mature."
"They're from a destroyed train."
"These children were probably taken from a school by that Train Conductor; they all seem to know each other."
"What are you planning to do with these children?"
"..."
Er Dan suddenly fell silent, and after a long while, he said with a complex expression, "When they joined the train, my Inheritance Value was already credited. I plan to have them try mining. If they're slow, I'll just support them."
"Many trains sell or abandon the children the moment the Inheritance Value is credited."
"You can only gain Inheritance Value once."
"These children have already added Inheritance Value to my train; they won't add any to other trains. Those who buy them are usually..."
"After the apocalypse."
"Under immense mental pressure, many people do things they would never do in peacetime. There are many ways to release psychological pressure, and I understand that, especially since Train Conductors are under even more pressure."
"I also play with women, several women."
"But I still think some too beastly behaviors cannot be excused by the apocalypse."
"People must retain some humanity, even if just a trace."
"After being sold, they won't have a good end."
"..."
Chen Mang frowned slightly, thought for a moment, and then said, "Give these children to me. I'll take care of them. For you, having so many extra mouths to feed is too much of a burden."
"You... you'll take care of them?"
Er Dan was slightly stunned: "They have almost no labor value; this is a hot potato!"
In the eyes of a heartless Train Conductor, this was a batch of wealth. But in the eyes of a somewhat humane Train Conductor, it was indeed a hot potato.
"Yes."
Chen Mang nodded. In his heart, he was sure he would break into space in five years. Once in space, the time span would become long. These people who grew up on the Stellar would be more loyal to it; they would be the backbone of the Stellar in the future.
A few dozen mouths were nothing to him.
Since they were young, they didn't need to mine. They could be slowly trained through combat training spaces and various ingredients, teaching both theory and practical knowledge. These people would become his trusted aides in the future.
"Brother, let me remind you again, they won't add any Inheritance Value to your train after joining."
Chen Mang nodded and then smiled: "I know. I'll take care of them. Do you have somewhere to spend your Inheritance Value?"
"Not for now."
Er Dan shook his head: "It can only be used in certain special Fortuitous Encounter maps like the 'Black Market,' or when encountering a Black Market Merchant. I'll wait until I meet a Black Market Merchant. They don't appear in fixed locations; it's all about luck. Who knows when I'll meet one."
"Thirty seconds."
"What do you mean?"
Thirty seconds later.
The cloaked Black Market Merchant walked through several cars to the 6th car, standing expressionlessly in front of Er Dan, his voice hoarse.
"Foolish human, congratulations on encountering the mysterious and elusive great Black Market Merchant. You can use your Inheritance Value to buy any product from me."
"Here is the product list."
"Please state the product you wish to purchase."
"Remember, say the product number. The great Black Market Merchant has no time for idle chatter."
"You have one minute to choose."
"..."
"..."
Er Dan stared at the translucent panel that suddenly appeared in front of him, dumbfounded for a long while, then looked at Chen Mang sitting beside him and muttered, "What is this?"
"The Black Market Merchant."
"But... why is he on your train?"
"Oh, he's a Train Crew member, joined the Stellar."
"Since when can the Black Market Merchant join a train? Isn't he supposed to be mysterious and elusive?"
"Isn't this mysterious? If you hadn't met me, would you have met this Black Market Merchant?"
"..."
Er Dan fell silent with a blank expression, then quickly selected two products. Looking at the blueprint in his hand and the retreating figure of the Black Market Merchant, he didn't know what to say.
The Black Market Merchant becoming a Train Resident.
These two words together were as incongruous as it gets!
"Brother, if only one train can survive this apocalypse, it will definitely be the Stellar."
"I hope so," Chen Mang smiled.
"Please take me with you when the time comes."
"Sure."
Half an hour later, the conversation was over.
Chen Mang escorted Er Dan out of the car.
"Brother." Er Dan looked seriously at Chen Mang: "My train is quite damaged, so I won't wait for you. I need to hurry back to the Shahe Plain for repairs. I won't say much more; I remember this life-saving favor, and I'll find a way to repay you in the future."
"You should leave as soon as possible too."
"There's something strange about the Ice and Snow World area. It's not right. Even in summer, this area remains this cold, with thick snow covering the ground. Many trains only stay here for the 'Snowman Monsters'."
"Be careful."
"Alright."
Chen Mang watched as Er Dan returned to his Azure Dragon Train, waved to him out the window, and then the train gradually became smaller in the sky until it disappeared from view.
After parting with Er Dan.
He looked at the huge Zombie corpse not far away, which had been completely dismembered, with only some flesh and blood still being processed.
Next to it on the snow were piles of human remains and train fragments, all dug out from its stomach.
"Sprinkle some water, make an ice tomb."
"Alright."
The temperature in this area was very low, and soon an ice tomb was formed. If no one destroyed it, this ice tomb would remain here indefinitely.
Chen Mang walked up, lit three cigarettes, and stuck them in the ground as a farewell.
Then he turned to Lao Zhu and said softly.
"We currently have 4 Resident cars. In the future, we'll reduce that to 1 Resident car. Everyone will live in the 'Space Gate,' and the remaining 3 cars will be repurposed for other uses."
"But there's no rush."
"I just created a 'Space Gate' in the 8th Resident car. Arrange for someone to put a Refrigerator in there as a dormitory for the children."
"Also, find a few former teachers to train the newly received children."
"The training can include firearms, close combat, mech control, train knowledge, basic literacy, and logic. You come up with the curriculum, including the history of the Stellar Train and the setbacks encountered during its development. Feel free to embellish a bit."
"I hope these children will grow up to have absolute loyalty to the Stellar and become its backbone."
"Understood?"
"Understood." Lao Zhu nodded seriously, then turned to arrange the matter, though his eyes showed a flash of admiration as he left.
Lord Mang was thinking far ahead.
If these children grew up on the Stellar, they would definitely be absolutely loyal to it and would be much better than someone like Biao Zi, who wasn't professionally trained, since they were trained from a young age.
But the upfront cost was huge, and it would take a long time to see any return.
Most Train Conductors wouldn't think this way. The fact that Lord Mang could think this far ahead showed he was confident in surviving the apocalypse.
Twenty minutes later.
The flesh of this level 6 Zombie had been completely dismembered and stored in the train's Refrigerator.
After being here for so long, there hadn't been another Corpse Tide.
Perhaps after this Zombie King died, the other Corpse Tides lost control and wandered around the Kunlun Mountains, or maybe they entered this area from another direction.
After handling the matters here.
Chen Mang controlled the Stellar Train, switched to the "Bunny Cloud" wheels, and flew high into the sky, heading deep into the "Ice and Snow World" green zone, towards the coordinates Er Dan had given him, where the Zombie King had broken free.
He wanted to see for himself.
As he went deeper into the Ice and Snow World, the blizzard became more intense. Along the way, he encountered a few trains, but their wheels weren't Wind-Fire Wheels or Spider Legs.
They were "Track Wheels" and "Sleds."
Basically, these two types of wheels.
Track Wheels could move directly, but Sleds couldn't. Trains equipped with Sleds had several "Tail Thrusters," using them as power to move across the snow.
The Armor of the trains he encountered was mostly damaged, showing that the Zombie King had a significant impact on this area. This area was small, much smaller than the Shahe Plain.
There were also many snow-capped mountains.
He could see several continuous snow-capped mountains, but they weren't as numerous as in the Kunlun Mountains area; there were still many flat areas. The actual terrain wasn't clear, but the snow was flat.
The snow here was very solid.
When you stepped on it, you wouldn't sink too deep; it might look like only a few centimeters, but the snow underneath could be several meters thick.
"Mining is going to be a problem."
Chen Mang frowned slightly, looking around. Staying here too long, snow blindness could also be an issue. This area felt even worse than the Kunlun Mountains area; keeping warm was another problem.
So far, the resource mines he'd detected were mostly on the mountain slopes; there were hardly any underground.

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 152 "Congratulations, Train Conductor."
chapters.content:
"..."
As they traveled, Chen Mang glanced at the items placed on the table nearby and chuckled softly without saying a word.
Although it was just a level 6 monster, the rewards were exceptionally generous.
On the control panel screen, two lines of text floated.
-
"You have defeated the level 7 ancient boss 'Mechanical Zombie King.'"
"You have gained 30 Reputation Points."
-
The panel displayed a level 7 boss.
This further confirmed his speculation was correct. If the Corpse Tide had fed all the flesh and blood to that Zombie King, it might have fully ascended to a level 7 boss. By then, the map would likely have changed, as this was a green zone, which could only accommodate up to level 6 Zombies.
However.
There weren't many monsters or people on the Shahe Plain to begin with. Even if the Corpse Tide hadn't been intercepted by him and had successfully arrived, the amount of flesh and blood they brought would have been far from enough to allow the Zombie King to evolve to level 7.
After listening to Er Dan's account.
This "Mechanical Zombie King" boss was essentially a major event that had been triggered prematurely by Er Dan. The large number of monsters in the Kunlun Mountains region were likely prepared in advance to serve as blood offerings for the Mechanical Zombie King's evolution.
But man proposes, and heaven disposes.
Er Dan accidentally triggered the event early, and the large number of blood offerings in the Kunlun Mountains region had been hidden away. The Corpse Tide was forced to head to the Shahe Plain to plunder blood offerings for their king, only to encounter him.
The Corpse Tide was slaughtered by him, and the Zombie King was sent to the afterlife with a single missile.
Thus, what should have been a major event was hastily concluded. However, Chen Mang still planned to go and investigate the collapsed mountain to see what was going on.
"Ancient boss?"
Chen Mang raised an eyebrow slightly, unsure of what exactly an ancient boss was. Could it be a boss born from the apocalypse of another planet that had somehow ended up in this world?
But perhaps it was precisely because of this unusual prefix that he was given an extra 30 Reputation Points.
The loot was also quite good.
There were three items.
-
1: Green Grade Vehicle Component Blueprint, "Vehicle-Mounted Zombie Perception Blocker."
2: Special Item, "Biohazard" Map Chip.
3: 10 Murphy Stones.
-
Among these, the second item was something he had never seen before. It wasn't a chip to unlock a Fortuitous Encounter map but required pairing with a level 5 "Combat Training Virtual Space" to use.
The Combat Training Virtual Space offered many map options. When this accessory reached level 10, the physical fitness improvements gained from training in the virtual space would also be amplified in the real world.
By inserting this chip into the "Combat Training Virtual Space,"
a special map would appear—the Biohazard map.
Each successful completion of the map would directly increase the Physical Fitness Index by 0.2, up to three times for normal completion.
There was also a "Limit Break" completion, which increased the difficulty.
Each successful Limit Break completion would increase the Physical Fitness Index by 0.5, also up to three times.
However, if you chose the Limit Break completion and died in the map, you would enter a brain-dead state in the real world.
Theoretically.
Everyone could gain a maximum of 2.1 Physical Fitness Index from the "Biohazard" map. Of course, this was theoretical, as the danger of Limit Break completion was too high. But at the very least, you could get a 0.6 Physical Fitness Index increase.
"Not bad."
Chen Mang smiled as he stuffed these items into the drawer. Anything that could increase the Physical Fitness Index was a good thing. In the future, he could control more mechs. He had seen Zhang Da Mei's combat footage from last night in the Train Log. Not bad, the mechs were quite useful.
The 10 Murphy Stones could also be traded. Not bad at all.
That missile wasn't a waste.
Although he didn't know what an ancient boss was, he hoped that any future bosses he encountered would also be ancient bosses. Of course, they shouldn't be too high-level—he couldn't handle that. Level 6 felt just right.
At this moment—
The Stellar Train slowly flew over the collapsed mountain. At a glance, there was a huge gap at the top of the snowy mountain. The Zombie King had emerged from this gap earlier.
Both the "Resource Detection Radar" and the "Targeting Radar" showed no abnormalities in the mountain.
No minerals, no monsters.
Chen Mang narrowed his eyes slightly and piloted the train to descend through the gap at the mountain's peak. The entire mountain was almost hollowed out, and at the very top of the mountain's interior were countless massive steel frames.
Each steel frame was extremely thick and had a heavy, substantial feel.
The Zombie King had been fixed to the top of the mountain by these steel frames, and during the landslide, its arm had been exposed.
On the walls at the base of the mountain were numerous constantly lit "Incandescent Lamps."
"Not monsters?"
Chen Mang descended thoughtfully. Neither the incandescent lamps nor the steel frames seemed like the work of monsters. He glanced at the train's screen, where all the accessories showed 100% durability, and the train's special skill, "Absolute Defense," was also intact. He wasn't too scared and continued to descend.
The next moment.
"Buzz, buzz, buzz—"
Dozens of drones flew out from the train and quickly headed down into the pit inside the mountain to gather information. A few days ago, after he had leveled a valley with a missile, he had acquired quite a few good items.
Among them was a blue-grade vehicle component blueprint, the "Swarm Platform."
It could be used to build and dock drones.
He had installed it outside the 7th Guard car. Each drone had the ability to gather information and was equipped with a small energy-powered machine gun that didn't consume ammunition but used Energy Stones.
One level 1 Energy Stone could keep a drone flying for hundreds of hours. If it needed to fire, it would depend on the level of the bullets. For level 3 bullets, it could fire continuously for 10 minutes.
This accessory had already been upgraded to level 10, and naturally, each drone was also level 10. Theoretically, it could fire level 10 bullets.
However.
A level 1 Energy Stone had too small a capacity and could only support firing up to level 3 bullets.
To fire level 10 bullets, at least a level 5 Energy Stone would be needed.
But the drones' primary function wasn't attack; their main purpose was reconnaissance. They were useful for clearing out small fry, but against a level 10 boss, drones wouldn't stand a chance.
Soon—
A large number of images were transmitted back to the "Train Auxiliary AI" by the drones, and after being edited and pieced together by the AI, they formed a complete picture. At the very bottom was a massive plaza.
Surrounding the plaza were many mechanical arms and frames.
No monsters or robots.
Several minutes later.
The Stellar Train slowly landed on the plaza. The plaza was covered in various strange patterns, and around it were many tall frames with mechanical arms installed on them.
The entire place looked like a rocket launch site.
But there was no rocket in sight.
"Well, well—"
Chen Mang was slightly awed as he looked around the plaza. At the edge of the plaza was a massive five-story-tall frame, on which were placed many large firepower weapons: rockets, heavy machine guns, exoskeleton armor, enormous chainsaws, and greatswords, among others.
There were also many ammunition crates.
The caliber of the heavy machine gun was even larger than that of his "Doomsday Cannon."
A single burst from that would terrify both man and ghost.
He looked up through the skylight at the massive gap in the mountain's interior ceiling and the countless incandescent lamps on the inner walls. He finally understood why this boss was called the "Mechanical Zombie King" and what this place was for.
Under normal circumstances.
When the time was right, the Zombie at the very top would have fallen onto this plaza, and these frames and mechanical arms would have installed all these weapon accessories onto the Zombie, turning it into a... large-scale killing machine.
Similar to the "Stellar Gen 3 Mech" he had seen in the Mechanical City.
Only this one was larger and equipped with even more firepower.
"Can I take these things with me...?"
Chen Mang looked greedily at the large firepower accessories placed on the nearby frame. These firepower accessories weren't designed for humans; they were larger than people.
They were originally designed for that Zombie.
Though there were many firepower accessories, compared to the Zombie, they weren't that large and could all be installed on the Zombie.
They would also be great to have on the train. Although they weren't train accessories and might become unusable once the ammunition ran out, they were free. And free stuff like this—the more, the merrier. He'd take as much as he could get.
"Xiao Ai."
"Send Biao Zi down with a team to check things out."
"Yes."
"Merit, merit, merit!!!"
As the door of the 7th Guard car opened, Biao Zi, his face filled with excitement, tightened the belt on his tactical suit, grabbed his rifle, and led a team out of the train. They began carefully inspecting the unusual aspects of the plaza from the edges.
It was time for him to earn some merit again.
Well.
Even if he found something, it wouldn't technically count as earning merit—it was just part of his job. But... at least it was a small achievement.
Although he was excited.
Once he started carrying out the task, Biao Zi immediately entered a cautious state. With a tense expression, he quickly searched the small frames around the edges. Around the plaza were many tall frames, similar to those used to secure rockets before launch.
Aside from the tall frames, there were also many small frames only about a meter high.
On them were placed various tools.
"No dust."
Biao Zi frowned slightly as he picked up a wrench and examined it. He then rubbed his finger on the frame. How could there be no dust here, no matter how long this place had existed? There must be a ventilation system running.
Was the ventilation system that effective?
The frame in front of him was basically filled with various tools, while the frames next to it held armor, weapons, and the like.
"Hmm?"
Biao Zi suddenly froze, a flash of excitement in his eyes. These armor and weapons clearly weren't designed for the train—they were smaller, the kind used for mechs. Could there be mechs here?
If there was a mech that didn't require too high a Physical Fitness Index,
maybe he could finally have his own mech!
With this thought, Biao Zi searched even more eagerly.
He then looked back at the team members behind him but didn't speak. Instead, the command was transmitted through the Hive Mind to Director Ai, who then relayed the command to the team members via the Iris Chip. In an instant, the command was silently delivered.
Immediately after.
All the team members nodded in unison and dispersed to search the area.
"Train Conductor."
Xiao Ai's cold, mechanical voice sounded in the train's cabin. "First, it can be determined that the patterns carved into the plaza are not a maze—they don't meet the basic criteria for a maze."
"Nor are they any form of writing."
"As for whether they're related to mysticism or some other form of writing, my database has no relevant information."
"However..."
"They do indeed resemble some form of ritual."
"A ritual?"
On the control panel screen, a flat image of the plaza's patterns soon appeared.
At the same time, Xiao Ai's voice sounded in his ear.
"Assume I pour a bucket of blood from this position. The blood would flow through the carved channels and spread across all the patterns, like this."
On the screen, the leftmost depression on the flat image of the patterns, resembling a small pool, slowly turned red. Soon, all the patterns turned red as Xiao Ai simulated what would happen if blood were poured into the depression.
"..."
Chen Mang didn't speak further, merely narrowing his eyes as he looked out the window at the plaza's patterns. He piloted the Stellar Train to rise and land on the open space around the plaza. If there was a possibility of a ritual, it was better not to stay foolishly on the plaza.
Otherwise, he might end up being the one being sacrificed!
This place was a mix of rituals, Zombies, and mechanical firepower—quite the hodgepodge!
Thirty minutes later.
"Train Conductor, Biao Zi and his team have finished their investigation. The specific information has appeared on the screen. Additionally, there's a chip, which is stored in a transparent box."
"On the box is a line of text."
"..."
Chen Mang looked down at the transparent box containing the chip in his hand. The chip inside was about the size of a small fingernail and looked very much like the memory card of a cell phone from the old era of his previous world.
On the box was written:
"Mechanical Zombie King Construction Plan!"
"Can you download the information from this chip?" he asked, turning to Xiao Ai.
"Of course."
Xiao Ai stepped forward, took the transparent box, and carefully inserted the chip into the interface of the "Train Auxiliary AI" on the control panel. His voice was mechanical and cold. "Provided the chip isn't encrypted at too high a level."
One minute later.
Xiao Ai's voice sounded again in the train's cabin. Though his voice remained the same cold, mechanical electronic tone, there was a hint of admiration and joy in it.
"Congratulations, Train Conductor."
"This is a ruin similar to the Mechanical City, though it's not a Fortuitous Encounter map. This chip contains detailed instructions on how t
o create the 'Mechanical Zombie King,' a terrifying killing machine."
"And..."
"All the valuable items here are hidden beneath the plaza. To open the plaza requires a large amount of flesh and blood—not just blood."
"The password is the patterns."
"And the key is the large amount of Zombie flesh and blood in your refrigerator, Train Conductor."
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 153: "Not Leaving a Single Brick, Tile, Needle, or Thread!"
chapters.content:
"Hmm?"
Xiao Ai's voice rang in his ear. Chen Mang raised an eyebrow, a flicker of surprise in his eyes. "Are you saying the Zombie flesh and blood I just collected happens to be the key?"
"What a coincidence."
"Yes."
Xiao Ai continued, "According to the information recorded in the chip, the entire creation process of this Mechanical Zombie King involves first controlling a Level 6 Zombie that is about to evolve into a Level 7 Zombie."
"Then, following the normal evolution process, when the Level 6 Zombie evolves into a Level 7 Zombie after obtaining enough flesh and blood nourishment, its plasticity will greatly increase."
"The flesh and blood brought back by the Corpse Tide can not only serve as evolutionary nourishment but also trigger the mechanism. During the period when the Zombie's plasticity is at its peak, firepower weapons like rocket launchers and chainsaws are permanently embedded into the Zombie, thereby gaining even greater power."
"The giant funnel next to it is where the flesh and blood are to be placed."
"The flesh and blood placed in the funnel will flow into the depression on the square that was just pointed out. When the blood fills the patterns on the entire square, that will be the moment when this Mechanical Zombie King reaches its complete form."
"..."
Chen Mang narrowed his eyes slightly, not speaking. It was truly a stroke of luck to stumble upon this. Who would have thought that the Ice and Snow World would hide such a ruin? It seems that each region has a special ruin.
For example, the "Tower of Heaven" and "Goblin Ruins" in the Shahe Plain, as well as the "Underwater Labyrinth."
The "Armory," a unique encounter map for the Flesh Train in the Kunlun Mountains.
This Mechanical Zombie King in the Ice and Snow World.
These places all belong to the category where, if you enter and can make it out alive, you can basically bring back an opportunity. The difference lies in the size of the opportunity, meaning there are likely many other lucky individuals in different regions who have obtained these opportunities and developed extremely rapidly.
Even the Iron Ridge Wasteland, a beginner's white zone, has a unique place like the Doomsday Abyss.
From this perspective.
The main improvements for the Train, besides speed, defense, attack, and living conditions, should also include adaptability to different environments. This way, it can explore more encounter maps. Trains like the Azure Dragon, which can operate on land, water, and air, have a natural advantage when exploring these encounter maps.
His Stellar Train still doesn't have the ability to dive underwater. Although he obtained the "Propeller" in the Kunlun Mountains region last time, which allows the Train to travel underwater, it still lacks some special components to officially gain the ability to navigate underwater, such as waterproofing.
Chen Mang didn't linger too long. He immediately controlled the Stellar Train to fly in the air, hovering it above the giant funnel on the nearby overpass. Then, the door of Carriage No. 3 opened.
Biao Zi and the others moved a refrigerator to the door and tilted it at a certain angle.
The next moment—
"Boom, boom..."
Like a floodgate releasing water, a large amount of viscous blood formed an arc in the air and heavily poured into the funnel in front of them, followed by chunks of Zombie flesh.
Zhang Da Mei stood to the side, occasionally poking her curved knife into the refrigerator to unclog it when it got blocked.
Although the refrigerator contained a lot of Zombie flesh, its weight remained unchanged.
After pouring for more than ten minutes, the Zombie flesh in the refrigerator was finally completely emptied.
The Zombie flesh in this refrigerator was all obtained from slaughtering the Corpse Tide.
As for the flesh of the Level 6 Zombie King, Chen Mang didn't want to use it. After all, it was of a higher level, and the flesh was also of a higher grade. Although he didn't know what the higher grade was good for, there might be a use for it in the future. For example, wasn't the flesh from the Corpse Tide also useful?
This further strengthened his resolve: as long as he didn't lack storage space, he would take everything he saw. Sooner or later, it would come in handy.
It could remain unused for a long time.
But he couldn't afford to not have it when it was needed.
At this moment, the funnel was already filled with Zombie flesh. A large amount of blood flowed down the funnel into the depression on the square, gradually filling the patterns on the entire square. When the patterns on the square were completely filled with blood—
"Buzz, buzz, buzz..."
Suddenly, the sound of rapidly spinning gears echoed.
The incandescent lamps inside the mountain above them also began to emit red light and flash rapidly.
The square cracked open in the middle, splitting into eighteen petals and slowly rotating clockwise inward.
Soon.
The original square transformed into a dark hole.
Below the hole was a workshop filled with various instruments.
Countless mechanical arms began to swing rapidly, picking up weapons from the nearby overpass and stabbing into the void, as if executing a pre-set program. All the firepower weapons, without exception, clattered down into the workshop below the square.
"Let's go down and take a look."
Chen Mang controlled the Stellar Train to descend into the workshop below the square. Inside, the indicator lights of countless instruments were flashing red, green, and various other colors. He couldn't understand them, but...
He saw a blueprint on the table.
That, he could understand.
Soon, this blueprint was retrieved by Biao Zi and the others and handed to him.
"Not bad."
Chen Mang looked at the blueprint in his hand and smiled. A new Mecha Blueprint, a yellow-grade Mecha Blueprint called "Leech," which was of a higher grade than Zhang Da Mei's "Executioner" Mecha, and its focus was also different.
This Mecha had almost no melee weapons, relying entirely on long-range firepower weapons.
In addition.
There was something even more precious: the chip currently inserted into the Train Auxiliary AI.
"Train Conductor."
In the train room, Xiao Ai's cold and mechanical electronic voice sounded, "This chip contains a lot of information, data, and details about Mecha modification and manufacturing. There are many tools and materials here. After collecting them, I can modify and upgrade the Mecha inside the Train in the future."
"Including those instruments, some are for testing armor data and rating it, such as whether it's Level 4 or Level 3 defense."
"Some are Mecha space compression instruments, which can compress a Mecha to the size of a briefcase."
"The circuits of these instruments can be connected to the generator. There should also be an Energy Stone here, and its level is not low. Otherwise, it wouldn't have been able to keep this laboratory in standby mode for so long."
This chip was what they had just found, right here in this laboratory.
The smile in Chen Mang's eyes was almost overflowing. He immediately waved his hand.
"Pack it all up!"
"Not leaving a single brick, tile, needle, or thread!"
Theoretically, Mecha are not allowed to be upgraded. For example, the armor and giant axe of the "Executioner" Mecha, created using a green Mecha Blueprint, are both Level 4. This cannot be upgraded. As the Train grows stronger, such a grade of Mecha can only be abandoned.
But with these tools.
He can use Level 5 armor materials to replace the Level 4 armor on the "Executioner" Mecha, modifying and upgrading it.
The laboratory had a large amount of raw materials and instruments.
The raw materials were easy to move, and they were basically left to Zhang Da Mei to handle, as they were too heavy. Using a Mecha to move them was the most suitable. However, the instruments required careful disassembly. But with the AI remotely directing through the Iris Chip, there were no major mistakes.
After emptying the entire laboratory.
They also stuffed all the overpasses and firepower weapons on the square into the "Space Gate" embedded in Carriage No. 2.
In addition.
They found a Level 10 Generator and a Level 5 Energy Stone, both of which were packed up and taken away.
One hour later.
Chen Mang had already controlled the Stellar Train to fly out of the mountain.
They returned fully loaded and triumphant, but the mysterious base behind them was left in complete disarray. Everything that could be taken had been taken.
Including the square and the gears inside the mountain, Chen Mang also wanted to pack them up and take them away.
However, during the violent disassembly process, perhaps some mechanism was triggered, causing the entire mountain to collapse rapidly. They had no choice but to give up and leave.
"Level 5 Energy Stone."
In the control room, Chen Mang looked at the pigeon egg-sized Energy Stone in his hand with a smile. This was his first Level 5 Energy Stone. His "Fabrication Table" could also create Level 5 Energy Stones, but he had never made one before.
Firstly, there was no need.
Both his Train head and generator were each embedded with a Level 3 Energy Stone.
But that was already more than enough.
A Level 3 Energy Stone required 50,000 units of Iron Ore, which was not cheap.
To create a Level 5 Energy Stone, it would require a whopping 5 million units of Iron Ore. He didn't have that much Iron Ore. Although, due to who knows how long it had been in standby mode, this Level 5 Energy Stone's capacity was only 19%.
But it was enough.
It was equivalent to picking up nearly 1 million units of Iron Ore for free.
At this moment, everything from the mysterious base had been moved and stored in the "Space Gate" in Carriage No. 2.
"Xiao Ai."
Chen Mang turned his head to look at Xiao Ai and tossed him a brand new Level 3 Energy Stone, "Name this Space Gate 'Mecha Research and Development Center.' From now on, this place will be under your management."
"For now, we can't create the kind of giant Mecha we encountered in the Mechanical City."
"This Level 3 Energy Stone should be enough."
"You've absorbed the data from both chips now. Make something out of it, okay?"
"No problem."
"Then let's head back and prepare for some rest!"
Chen Mang played with the Level 5 Energy Stone in his hand for a while before putting it into a drawer. Using this Energy Stone to provide energy would be a waste. Currently, the components inside the Train didn't require this level of energy. It could be stored for future use in some "Energy Cannons" as a strategic reserve.
As dusk approached.
The Stellar Train returned to the Shahe Plain. They found a flat area and began to rest in place, not in a hurry to search for Iron Ore. After working non-stop for 48 hours, even a man of iron needed a day's rest.
It wouldn't be too late to continue tomorrow.
There was no need to rush.
A lot of things needed to be prepared first, such as the yellow-grade Mecha Blueprint "Leech" in his hand.
3 meters tall.
Equipped with Level 6 Armor, some essential Mecha components, and no melee weapons whatsoever.
On its back was a twin-mounted large-caliber cannon, serving as the main gun.
On each shoulder was a square rocket pod containing nine rockets.
It carried two arm-mounted rotating automatic cannons.
There were propulsion jets on the soles of its feet, the lower back, and the arms.
Pure firepower suppression!
The only means of dealing with enemies at close range was to shove the rotating automatic cannon into their mouths. All firepower weapons were up to Level 6, using Energy Stones as ammunition, and could choose between Level 1 to Level 6 bullets.
If using Level 1 ammunition, a Level 3 Energy Stone could sustain full combat for 600 minutes.
If using Level 6 ammunition, a Level 3 Energy Stone could sustain full combat for 30 seconds.
The cost-performance ratio was quite high.
A Level 3 Energy Stone only cost 50,000 units of Iron Ore, which was a drop in the bucket for the Train. The most energy-consuming part was the twin-mounted large-caliber cannon on the back. If not using this, it could extend to 60 seconds.
Crafting it required 28,000 Crimson Heartstones.
Without hesitation, Chen Mang immediately crafted this "Leech" Mecha.
The physical fitness index requirement for piloting it was extremely low, only 10.5.
Basically, everyone on the Train met this condition, even the Train Residents, as they worked every day and ate bread that could enhance their physical fitness. Their physical fitness index had long surpassed that of a normal adult male.
However, the mental requirement was quite high.
"The pilot's physical fitness index must be above 10.5, and mental strength must be above 14.0. At above 14.5, it can unleash its full power."
"Xiao Ai."
"The Iris Chip Resident Data Panel doesn't have a mental strength option, right?"
"Add the option to quantify mental strength and see who has a mental strength above 14.0."
"Okay."
This Mecha's consumption was much higher than the "Executioner," but that was normal. After all, one was Level 4, and the other was Level 6, and there was also the difference between melee and long-range combat. Naturally, the energy consumption was different.
If the Train ever ran out of Copper Ore.
This "Leech" Mecha could provide the Train with its final firepower support, as Energy Stones were made from Iron Ore.
And in areas where the Train couldn't enter.
The Mecha unit could also extend the Train's influence and attack range, acting like the Train's tentacles, delivering a heavy blow to the enemy under the guidance of various data and information provided by the Iris Chip AI.
However, he had only ever seen one Crimson Heartstone mine.
To create a Mecha squad.
They would still need enough Crimson Heartstones and a sufficient physical fitness index for the Guardian squad.
"By the way, Xiao Ai."
"Take that 'Biohazard' map chip and insert it into the Combat Training Virtual Space. Let them know about this."
"Understood."
"Biao Zi."
Under the dusk, Lao Zhu walked up to Biao Zi, who was standing in a daze, and sighed lightly before patting his shoulder, "Don't be too down. It's just a Mecha. And didn't you prefer Zhang Da Mei's melee Mecha? Li Shi Ji's firepower support Mecha doesn't suit your personality anyway."
Yes.
The second Mecha of the Stellar Train, the yellow-grade Mecha "Leech."
Its owner was Li Shi Ji.
