chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 182: "Mechanical Train Parts Store."
chapters.content:
"Ahem."
Noticing Biao Zi's dejection, Shan Mao Zi followed him and coughed lightly before offering some comfort: "Biao Ge, you don't need to be too disheartened. Both of them are from our team, and there are only three people on the entire Stellar Train who can pilot the Thunder Mech."
"Our team has two of them."
"That makes our team even stronger, doesn't it?"
"..."
Biao Ge shot a resentful glance at Shan Mao Zi: "Obviously, do you think I don't know that?"
Then he strode off towards the Combat Training Virtual Space, determined to continue his training. Unfortunately, there were only two maps available, and even if he cleared both, there was a limit to his progress. If only he could have two more map chips, his potential would be much higher.
But he also knew.
Map chips were extremely rare. Many trains didn't even have one, and the fact that the Stellar Train had two was already a testament to Lord Mang's capabilities. Obtaining a third one wouldn't be easy.
In the short term, there wasn't much he could do to quickly push the limits of his physical fitness index.
This also meant that, for now, he wouldn't have a chance to pilot the Thunder Mech.
Could he not feel resentful?
He was utterly resentful, feeling like he was turning into Lin Daiyu.
"Is it reacting now?"
Inside the Stellar Train, Chen Mang looked at the ticket glowing red under the walkie-talkie. This was something he had exchanged for a Murphy Stone on the train radio some time ago.
-
Special Item: Neon City Ticket.
Item Effect: An entry ticket to the fortuitous encounter map 'Neon City.' When this ticket emits a red light, crushing it will grant access to this fortuitous encounter map.
-
It was finally reacting, continuously glowing red.
The flashing was slowing down, and it was expected to completely extinguish in about a minute. If he didn't crush the ticket within that time, he would miss this opportunity.
He immediately crushed it.
Soon, a panel appeared before him.
Fortuitous Encounter Map: Neon City.
The train cannot enter. A maximum of 11 people can enter. Please have the Train Conductor select 10 members from the train crew to accompany them. The Train Conductor must go.
"The train can't enter?"
Chen Mang picked up the walkie-talkie and contacted Xiao Ai: "Have the nine members of the Guardian Team One and Li Shiji come to the train compartment. While I'm away, I'm giving you full authority over all firepower components and resource allocation. If any train approaches, issue one warning. If they don't comply, open fire immediately."
"If you can't win, evacuate the residents first."
By now, the ticket had turned into countless light particles, forming a portal beside him. When he exited the fortuitous encounter map, he would return to the train compartment.
Soon—
The nine members of Guardian Team One and Li Shiji had all arrived, fully armed. Biao Zi, in particular, looked relieved. He had just entered the Combat Training Virtual Space and hadn't yet entered the map, so he could still join this mission.
Otherwise, such a great opportunity to earn merit would have slipped away.
"This fortuitous encounter map is unknown, so everyone, stay safe."
Chen Mang took all the special items he could carry and even had Zhang Yi carry a refrigerator filled with supplies, including enough food and water, as well as 15 off-road motorcycles.
Right after.
Biao Zi took the lead and strode into the portal, followed closely by a group of Guardians who filed in one after another.
After passing through the portal.
The scene before them opened up almost instantly, giving a feeling akin to entering the Peach Blossom Spring. Behind the portal was a square located in the heart of a bustling city, with nearly over 1,000 people standing in it.
The perimeter of the square was encircled by an air wall.
Above the square, there was a light screen introducing the rules of this Fortuitous Encounter map.
-
"Fortuitous Encounter Map: Neon City."
"This map prohibits mutual attacks and has no aggressive elements. It is an entertainment Fortuitous Encounter map."
"Created by the 'Mechanical Civilization,' this city has only one purpose: relaxation."
"However."
"It has been a long time since anyone set foot in this city seeking relaxation, and the city has long awaited the return of its master."
"If you are tired in the apocalypse, come here to relax."
"This city not only offers relaxation but also many Fortuitous Encounters waiting for you to explore."
"Maximum stay: 48 hours."
"Go forth and taste the forbidden fruit."
-
After quickly absorbing all the information from the light screen above, Chen Mang began to survey his surroundings. Nearly a thousand people around him were whispering and chatting, creating a cacophony of noise. Clearly, they were all Train Conductors.
Assuming each Train Conductor could bring 10 Train Crew members.
There were probably around 100 Train Conductors here.
He narrowed his eyes slightly as he observed the city. Everyone's spawn point was the central square of the city, which looked somewhat similar to the two mechanical cities he had visited before. However, this time, the skyscrapers were no longer the cold, oppressive black color.
There was no sense of oppression here.
It was great.
It seemed that the Mechanical Civilization wasn't solely about oppression.
However.
All the buildings were in dopamine-inducing colors—blue, purple, green, red, and more. Combined with the neon lights that could easily be called light pollution, the entire city looked like a rainbow, reminiscent of non-mainstream hair colors.
All the billboards and building lights were constantly illuminated.
You could even hear music playing in the streets.
But not a single pedestrian could be seen on the streets.
Chen Mang looked down at the wristwatch that had somehow appeared on his wrist. It displayed "Balance: 10,000 points," which was the currency of this city. With this, he could make purchases in the city's stores.
Just then—
The air wall slowly disappeared.
The crowd in the square immediately scattered in all directions, everyone in a hurry. Clearly, no one was too concerned about entertainment; they were all more interested in the Fortuitous Encounters this city had to offer.
Chen Mang was no exception.
He looked toward the west, where an extremely eye-catching billboard stood.
"Mechanical Train Parts Store."
Damn it!
There's even a store for this?
What the hell is there to hesitate about? Of course, he was going to spend! He wondered how much 10,000 points could buy.
The billboard was about a kilometer away.
Almost half of the people were sprinting down the street toward that store, afraid of being too slow.
"Tsk."
Chen Mang clicked his tongue and chuckled as he watched the crowd. Then, he swung his leg over the off-road motorcycle, twisted the throttle, and roared down the wide street toward the store a kilometer away!
"Vroom! Vroom!!"
Biao Zi and the others drove off-road motorcycles, twisting the throttle to follow closely behind Lord Mang.
No matter how fast one runs, how could they possibly outpace wheels!
In the blink of an eye, Chen Mang and his group had already overtaken the main force, speeding along the wide, deserted street toward the "Mechanical Train Parts Store" at the end of the road!
Especially eye-catching was the refrigerator Zhang Yi was carrying on his shoulder.
"Huh?"
A Train Conductor, who had been running with his head down, suddenly heard the sound of engines behind him. He paused briefly, but before he could react, a group of people on off-road motorcycles zoomed past him, leaving him dumbfounded on the spot.
He instinctively stopped.
Turning to look back at the square, he wondered if there were shared motorcycles available for rent there.
He hadn't noticed any.
But in the midst of the crowd, the moment he stopped, he was knocked down from behind, and countless feet trampled over his head.
Three minutes later.
The man struggled to get up from the ground. He felt no pain or injuries—this map prohibited mutual attacks. The moment he fell, a faint yellow light enveloped him, protecting him from harm, though he was left somewhat disheveled.
Most importantly—
He had lost contact with his thugs. Looking around, he realized he was alone. His expression turned grim as he shouted toward the marathon-like scene on the street ahead.
"People from the King of Electronic Music Train, stop running, damn it, come back!"
But clearly, in such chaos, his voice didn't carry as far as he had hoped.
Cursing under his breath, he continued to follow!
Why did those people have motorcycles? Wasn't that cheating?!
And, though he wasn't sure if it was just his imagination, the leader of the group seemed somewhat familiar. He had only caught a glimpse as they passed by, so he couldn't be certain.
Soon—
Chen Mang parked his off-road motorcycle in front of the "Mechanical Train Parts Store." The crowd on the street behind him was still running desperately. He jumped off the motorcycle and, with Biao Zi and the others, strode into the store.
Meanwhile, Zhang Yi, carrying the refrigerator, was responsible for storing all the off-road motorcycles inside it.
Otherwise, they would definitely be stolen—or worse, taken by force.
The store's entrance was massive, with the doorway alone stretching ten meters long.
As soon as they entered the store.
"Welcome."
A pleasant voice suddenly rang in their ears. Chen Mang turned his head and saw a woman standing at the entrance, smiling at him. She was quite attractive, but her appearance made it clear she was a robot.
"This is the Mechanical Train Parts Store. You can purchase any items here."
"You are free to browse the first floor. The second floor is restricted to Train Conductors of level 10 and above. Your current level does not meet the requirement, sir."
"Are there any living people in this city?"
Chen Mang glanced around the store before asking.
The woman didn't respond, continuing to smile at him. Clearly, this question was beyond her database. Her intelligence level wasn't high, far inferior to Xiao Ai's.
Chen Mang didn't press further. Instead, he led Biao Zi and the others into the store.
The store was spacious.
Only a row of cabinets lined the walls, each cabinet divided into three layers. Every 10 centimeters on each layer, a screen displayed product information, prices, and stock levels.
"Drill Bit Blueprint": White-grade Vehicle Component, priced at 15,000 points, stock: 2.
"Lighter Production Line Blueprint": White-grade Vehicle Component, priced at 8,000 points, stock: 1.
"Custom Screen Production Line Blueprint": Green-grade Vehicle Component, priced at 30,000 points, stock: 4.
"."
"Murphy Stone": Special Item, priced at 100,000 points, stock: 18.
"."
"Zombie Siege": Special Item, Map Chip, requires Level 5 'Combat Training Virtual Space' to use, priced at 50,000 points, stock: 1.
"."
-
The store was filled with a dazzling array of nearly a hundred items, though the stock for most was quite limited. Many items had a stock of 0, likely due to a long period without restocking.
This city had been abandoned for a long time.
Perhaps even before they arrived, the neon lights of this city had not been lit for ages.
Although it was just the first level of the area.
But the goods were all high-quality, and there were many things he desired, such as the "Zombie Siege" Map Chip. However, the price...
Chen Mang glanced down at the 10,000-point balance on his wristwatch. This was the initial balance given to every Train Conductor, and only the Train Conductor had it. The Train Crew members did not receive any. With this amount, he could only afford a white-grade Accessory Blueprint.
And even then, only the more basic ones.
Slightly better white-grade components cost over 10,000 points, which was beyond his means.
In other words.
This store was essentially set up for them to look at, not for them to actually purchase anything. At this moment, several Train Conductors, panting heavily, rushed into the store with their subordinates, their eyes filled with excitement and anxiety.
As if they were afraid Chen Mang would buy up all the good items.
But soon.
After seeing the prices, these people fell into a sullen silence, realizing that with their current balance, they couldn't afford anything in the store.
One Train Conductor cursed as he walked out of the store, sneering coldly as he passed Chen Mang.
"Being fast doesn't help much."
"."
Chen Mang ignored the man and instead led Biao Zi and the others out of the store. Standing on the street, he looked up at the towering skyscrapers with their flickering neon lights and smiled.
He always believed one thing.
There was no such thing as a useless item.
Since the store had appeared, it must have been meant to serve them. If their balance wasn't enough, then they just needed to earn more points.
"How's your gambling skill?"
He turned to Li Shiji with a smile.
"If it's about gambling..."
Li Shiji shook his head firmly. "I'm completely clueless."
"Let's give it a try."
Chen Mang gestured for Zhang Yi to retrieve the off-road motorcycle from the Refrigerator. "A city focused on entertainment must have casinos, amusement centers, and the like. This map must have places where we can earn points."
"Let's go find them."
"Our advantage is that we have transportation, allowing us to explore more of this city."
"How much cola did we bring? Let's not sleep for the next 48 hours."
"We brought over 200 cans."
"That's enough."
Chen Mang mounted the off-road motorcycle, propping one foot on the ground as he looked ahead. He twisted the throttle again, and with a roar, sped down the street. He planned to first find a small store or newspaper stand to see if he could get a map of the city.
The newspaper office was probably nowhere to be found; the term didn't align with the architectural style of this city.
As expected.
There wasn't a single living soul in this city, only some pre-programmed robots serving as staff in every store.
Just then—
Biao Zi twisted the throttle and caught up, licking his lips with a hint of restless excitement.
"Lord Mang, it seems this city doesn't have any firepower equipment."
"How about we just try robbing it directly?"
"Let's pull off a big one!"
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 183: "Customized Pleasure Shop."
chapters.content:
As soon as Biao Zi finished speaking.
He noticed a commotion and exclamations from the crowd behind him. A group of people were suddenly enveloped by a red light membrane and then vanished in the blink of an eye. Judging by their actions before disappearing, they were clearly preparing to commit a robbery.
"Uh..."
Biao Zi awkwardly averted his gaze and continued to straddle his off-road motorcycle, following behind Lord Mang. It seemed this plan wouldn't work; this Fortuitous Encounter map strictly prohibited violent actions like attacks.
It was unclear whether those people had been sent back or had died.
Most likely, they were sent back.
All members of the Guardian squad could ride motorcycles. Even if some couldn't at first, they quickly got the hang of it after a few tries.
If you can walk, you can ride a bicycle. If you can ride a bicycle, you can ride an electric bike. And if you can ride an electric bike, you can ride a motorcycle. Learning wasn't difficult, especially in this post-apocalyptic world where there were no traffic rules—you could ride however you wanted.
"..."
Chen Mang led the way on his off-road motorcycle, swiftly scanning the shops on both sides of the street. Only about half of the shops were open for business, and through the glass doors, he could see robot attendants waiting inside.
There were many shops.
Among them, pleasure shops were the most common.
The street was wide enough to accommodate twenty Trains side by side. Every mechanical city road he had encountered was similarly spacious, as if they had been designed with Trains as the primary mode of transportation in mind.
"Pleasure Shop."
The neon lights on the signboard flickered incessantly. Chen Mang looked at the sign and stopped in front of the shop, which was located beneath an office building. He had passed by many pleasure shops without stopping, but he wasn't here for thrills.
Even if he were seeking excitement, Ji Chuchu would be far more entertaining than these robots.
However, the name of this shop was so blatantly explicit that it piqued his curiosity, compelling him to see what was inside.
By now, the street behind them was completely empty.
Only their group remained.
In this Fortuitous Encounter map, having a vehicle was a significant advantage. They could travel to any corner of the city, while others had to rely on their feet to get around slowly.
"This isn't appropriate..."
Biao Zi coughed lightly, his eyes filled with anticipation as he followed Lord Mang into the Pleasure Shop.
Meanwhile, Li Shiji, who had been tense all along, let out a slight sigh of relief.
He admitted that he was indeed quite capable and had accomplished several feats, but he wasn't omnipotent. Lord Mang even wanted him to participate in gambling, which had put immense pressure on him.
Now, this was better.
Playing around and relaxing sounded great—he really wasn't good at gambling.
The interior of the shop was overwhelmingly dopamine-inducing. The walls were painted in various colors, and the multicolored light sources created pure light pollution.
There was no sense of aesthetics whatsoever.
"..."
Chen Mang frowned slightly as he examined the shop's decor. He had come to realize that mechanical civilization had no sense of aesthetics. In the eyes of mechanical civilization, bright colors were considered beautiful and cheerful, but they had no concept of combining or coordinating these colors.
The result was an overwhelmingly chaotic visual experience.
The store had no shelves, only a robot waiter holding a tablet. When it saw the group approaching, it displayed a standard smile and aimed the tablet at them.
"Welcome. First floor for selection services, second floor for service."
Various options appeared on the tablet.
"1: AI Peak Pleasure, a unique code that can make an AI ecstatic, priced at 998 points."
"2: AI Mild Pleasure, suitable for more docile AIs, priced at 668 points."
"3: AI"
It was essentially a brothel.
A rather niche one, catering specifically to AIs.
After understanding what the store was about, Chen Mang shook his head and led Biao Zi and the others out. If he ever had the chance to return, he might consider bringing Xiao Ai along to give him some pleasure.
After all, Xiao Ai worked with him, and if there was an opportunity for enjoyment, he wouldn't leave his own people out.
However, before leaving the store, a vending machine at the entrance caught his eye.
The machine was stocked with various items.
"Lemon Cola, priced at 10 points."
"Lemon Cake, priced at 18 points."
"Eden City Map Chip Edition, 1000 points."
"Paper City Map, 20 points."
"."
After searching for a convenience store without success, he unexpectedly found what he needed here. Without much hesitation, Chen Mang took out 30 points and purchased a map and a bottle of lemon cola. The chip edition required an AI or robot to use, and since he hadn't brought Xiao Ai, he could only buy the paper version.
After placing his wristwatch on the payment interface, a can of cola and a rolled-up map were dispensed.
He opened the lemon cola and sniffed it—it wasn't expired. He took a small sip; it tasted normal, with no strange odors, and then handed the opened can to Biao Zi beside him.
"Drink it and see if it restores your stamina or has any other special effects."
The reason he bought this cola was purely out of curiosity.
The mechanical civilization should have long perished or be on the brink of extinction. This city hadn't been restocked in a long time, so he was curious whether the food items had expired. Surprisingly, they hadn't.
The cola can had no brand or production information, just the words "Lemon Cola" in bold.
There were only two possibilities.
Either the vending machine had a permanent preservation effect similar to a level 5 supermodel refrigerator, or this cola was produced in a way that it never expired.
The term "Mechanical Civilization" was something he had speculated about, but on the introduction screen of the Fortuitous Encounter map, the words "Mechanical Civilization" were explicitly mentioned.
These details revealed a lot.
It meant that their "Train" and "accessories" were inherited from the Mechanical Civilization, and their common enemy was the various monsters.
As the saying goes, "One leaf can reveal the autumn."
Such inconspicuous places often hold a wealth of information.
Chen Mang then left the store and unfolded the paper city map on the ground. The map was enormous, covering an area of nine square meters, with each side measuring three meters.
The city itself wasn't large.
The city they encountered at the "Geocentric Nuclear Bomb" was not as large as this one, probably only a quarter of its size. The map was so extensive because it meticulously detailed every street and shop, labeling them with excessive precision.
"..."
Chen Mang bent down, his brow furrowed in concentration as he examined the map spread out on the ground. The entire city had no residential areas, only a jumble of shops with names so bizarre that he couldn't even guess what they were for.
"Three Wonders Entropy Pawnshop."
"Daily 'Love' Pain Charging Station."
"Paradox Clock Shop of Marvelous Experiences."
"Mechanical Train Confession Room."
"Eden Memory Bank."
Among these chaotic shops, only the "Eden Memory Bank" gave him a vague idea of its purpose—it likely dealt with memories or something related. The rest were complete mysteries.
On the map, there were three areas marked with prominent five-pointed stars, each covering a significant area.
They were labeled as—
Entertainment City, Entertainment City, and Entertainment City.
"Not bad."
Chen Mang rolled up the map and tossed it to Zhang Yi, who was standing nearby. He then glanced at the street signs for direction, mounted his off-road motorcycle, and with a twist of the throttle, roared down the street ahead!
Biao Zi and the others quickly followed suit, hopping onto their own off-road motorcycles.
This city was undoubtedly designed for entertainment and relaxation.
All three key areas were Entertainment Cities.
Moreover, from the information provided by these shops, one could deduce that the mechanical civilization wasn't solely composed of robots—there were also many humans, and they likely held a significant status. Otherwise, there wouldn't be things like cola and casinos.
At the very least.
He thought that a robot, a being whose core was made up of countless lines of code and data, probably wouldn't have a strong passion for gambling, a game of chance.
"Private Custom Culture Shop."
The Train Conductor of the King of Electronic Music Train had finally reunited with his thugs. He now stood in front of this "Private Custom Culture Shop," nodding with a satisfied smile.
His train had already reached level 4.
Back when he was heading to the Shahe Plain, he had wanted to see how the Stellar, which had been thriving in the Iron Ridge Wasteland, was faring in the Shahe Plain. But when he arrived, he couldn't find the Stellar's name on any of the leaderboards.
He had initially thought that perhaps the Stellar had fallen into obscurity or met with some disaster.
Curious, he asked about it on the Train Radio.
The response he got was nothing but "..."—three dots.
Later, he learned that during the days he was still mining in the white zones, the Stellar had already conquered the Shahe Plain and moved on to higher-level regions.
So fast.
He himself had only reached level 4 thanks to a certain opportunity, which was already considered quick. How could the Stellar be so much faster? It was truly baffling. It couldn't be that he had struggled until the end of the world to encounter one opportunity, while that guy stumbled upon them every other day.
But—
Now was not the time to dwell on this.
The Dwarf Man, also known as the Train Conductor of the King of Electronic Music Train, pushed open the door to the shop with a satisfied expression. The shop was hidden in a small alley, and if he hadn't been looking for a secluded spot to relieve himself, he would never have discovered it.
The interior of the shop was decorated in a predominantly red theme, giving off a rather ambiguous vibe.
At the entrance, a female robot server knelt, holding a tablet high in her arms.
-
"Private Customized Adult Entertainment Shop."
"All service personnel in this shop are anthropomorphic and realistic robots."
"Customize any type you desire."
"Height, race, skin tone, gender, age, etc."
-
"Hmm."
The Dwarf Man was quite satisfied with the kneeling service at the entrance. This way, he didn't have to look up, which suited him perfectly. He then turned his attention to the various options on the tablet, his mouth slightly agape as a hint of astonishment flashed in his eyes.
"There are actually 48 options for skin tone. Impressive."
"Let me see."
"Hmm, by default, can only choose the opposite sex, right?"
"Yes, sir. Same-sex is illegal."
"Got it. I'm not that kind of person anyway."
"...It requires an additional fee."
The Dwarf Man expressionlessly looked at the robot server kneeling before him, then pointed at the small text on the screen: "What does it mean that the prices for full-simulation and semi-simulation are the same?"
"The law stipulates that all mechanical beings must have visible mechanical organs in prominent areas to distinguish them from humans."
"Using full-simulation robots as service personnel in adult entertainment shops is illegal."
"So...?"
"It requires an additional fee."
"Wait, so it seems like this law doesn't really constrain you much, huh?"
"In Eden City, the law can be slightly relaxed."
"How relaxed exactly?"
"Depends on how much extra you pay."
"..." The Dwarf Man pursed his lips, not delving deeper. After a moment of contemplation, he spoke up: "Customize one for me, three meters tall, with a golden figure—curvy in all the right places. How much?"
"Please select your smart chip level."
"Level 1 Smart Chip": Capable of basic movements and sounds, priced at 1,800 points.
"Level 2 Smart Chip": Possesses intelligence similar to mine, priced at 4,900 points.
"Level 3 Smart Chip": Possesses near-human intelligence, priced at 12,800 points.
The robot server kneeling on the ground spoke in a calm voice, with a standard smile: "The higher the smart chip level, the better the experience you'll enjoy. Moreover, if you happen to develop feelings for a service personnel with a Level 3 smart chip..."
"You can redeem her."
"She is inserted into different bodies each time, so don't worry about her being 'dirty.' Her core is clean. As long as you craft a brand-new body for her, she will still meet the human preference for virginity."
"..."
The Dwarf Man expressionlessly looked at the woman kneeling on the ground. After a long silence, he finally whispered, "You guys really know how to play."
"Give me a Level 1 smart chip."
He then turned to the thugs behind him: "See if there's anything you guys want to play with. If so, I'll foot the bill. Just be careful when choosing—I only have 10,000 points, so don't overspend."
He had already checked out the Mechanical Train parts store.
With 10,000 points, he couldn't buy anything worthwhile, so he might as well have some fun here.
The thugs following him lit up at this. They loved this about their boss—when he got his share, he always made sure they got theirs too.
"Can I get a Zombie version? Not too gory, make it sexy."
"I want a pocket-sized one, about thirty centimeters tall."
"Just give me a normal one, but make the face pretty, um... make it look like you."
"Can I choose you?"
"."
Nearly half of the Train Conductors, almost a hundred of them, walked into the brothel to experience the brothel from the mechanical civilization—an entirely new experience.
If it weren't for the apocalypse.
They would never have had this kind of opportunity.
Although many of the services were somewhat too extreme, as long as it was labeled as an "experience," the acceptance level increased significantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 184: "Sun Entertainment City."
chapters.content:
Meanwhile.
Chen Mang had successfully led Biao Zi and the others to the first "entertainment city." The place was vast, resembling a castle at first glance. The spotlights from the rooftops of surrounding skyscrapers illuminated the castle's surface, giving it an air of opulence and decadence.
The castle was surrounded by a large artificial moat.
The architectural style wasn't medieval but rather futuristic. Huge billboards displayed photos of nude young women, and outside the castle, numerous staff members—all robots—were moving about. They were uniformly female, with strikingly beautiful faces, minimal clothing, and provocative movements.
"Let's go in and take a look."
There was no security.
Chen Mang twisted the throttle and drove toward the entertainment city. Before even reaching the main entrance, he saw scattered slot machines placed at the entrance.
"Does anyone know how to play these?"
"No."
Chen Mang didn't linger. He drove his motorcycle straight through the main entrance. He had never touched a slot machine before, only knowing the basic rule: pull the lever, and if three identical symbols appeared, you win.
The entertainment city had six floors.
The first floor, upon entering, was filled with hundreds of gambling tables. Each table was manned by a beautiful dealer in a red bikini. At that moment, nearly all the dealers turned their heads with smiles to look at them.
"Damn..."
Biao Zi instinctively took a step back, looking at the scene with a mix of awkwardness and unease. "Is this supposed to be sexy? Why does it feel a bit creepy to me?"
"If it weren't for the fact that this Fortuitous Encounter map is labeled as an entertainment map,"
"I'd think it was some kind of map with eerie elements."
"And where did all these guests come from?"
As soon as they stepped into the hall,
so many beautiful dealers turned their heads in unison to smile at them. The scene was indeed a bit unsettling. Fortunately, it was daytime, and the hall was well-lit. If it were nighttime, with flickering lights and eerie music playing,
they would have turned around and run without a second thought.
Hundreds of gambling tables.
Most were empty, but a small number had guests sitting at them. These guests looked red-eyed and highly emotional, constantly slamming chips onto the tables. The air was filled with the shouts of these gamblers.
"I don't believe it! Seven rounds in a row have been small. I'm going all in on big!"
"Hahaha, it's really big! It's really big! I've hit the jackpot!"
"I should've followed your bet."
"..."
Chen Mang scanned the gamblers and quickly came to a conclusion: "Without a doubt, these are probably the casino's shills—robots designed to create an atmosphere."
"Now that the city is empty, after being reactivated, these shills have started their work according to their programmed routines."
"But didn't the map indicate that the city's laws don't allow robots to fully mimic humans? They must display their mechanical organs in obvious areas."
"Look."
Chen Mang tilted his head toward the wall of the casino. "What does that sign say?"
"No smoking, no... no harassing the dealers?"
"Right."
Chen Mang nodded, pulled a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and exhaled a faint blue cloud of smoke. He then pointed toward a nearby gambling table where the occasional shouts of gamblers could be heard. "What do you think they're doing over there?"
"Dealing cards?"
At the table, there were four or five people. Three gamblers were excitedly raising their hands and shouting, while the fourth, clearly overly excited, stood behind the dealer, pressing the dealer's body firmly against the table. He kept grabbing chips and stuffing them into the dealer's clothes.
The dealer seemed quite cooperative.
If the entire entertainment city were packed with people, this scene wouldn't be too out of the ordinary. In fact, it would help stir up the guests' emotions. In an excited environment, people's emotions naturally rise, leading to more intense and faster-paced gambling.
But—
At this moment, the entertainment city was filled only with these plants, making the scene appear rather bizarre.
"I'll give it a try."
Biao Zi's eyes flashed with curiosity as he walked over to the nearest dealer. He mimicked the earlier actions, pressing the dealer against the table, when he heard the dealer's voice: "Sir, would you like to join? 100,000 points."
"Alright, you stay put, hands steady, legs still."
Biao Zi straightened the dealer and then returned to Lord Mang's side. "That's really expensive—100,000 points for one go. It's way pricier than those brothels."
"Here, what they're selling is the emotion."
Chen Mang rubbed his temples in frustration before heading toward the second floor. "Let's go. Maybe we can find a way to make some money upstairs. This mechanical civilization is pure capitalism—everything costs money."
Just then—
A burly man in a pink tank top approached them, holding a glass of champagne, his face friendly.
"Oh?"
Chen Mang's eyes flickered with surprise. The intelligence level of these plants was impressive. He wondered if it was programmed behavior, with the ability to interact with guests. The robots he had encountered in this city were far less intelligent than Xiao Ai and even those he had met in the Fortuitous Encounter map of the Tower of Heaven.
Most of them were rigidly programmed, staying in their designated spots, waiting for customers to enter their range before executing their service routines.
This was the first robot he had encountered that could actively interact with guests.
Although the burly man looked no different from a human, in this long-abandoned city, he could only be a robot.
The man in the pink tank top approached Chen Mang and his group, raised his hand in a delicate gesture, and then draped his arm over Biao Zi's shoulder. With a drunken look in his eyes, he bit his lip and offered the glass to Biao Zi.
"100,000 points, and you can lie down on that table over there."
"Huh?"
Biao Zi stared at the man in disbelief, instinctively wanting to throw a punch. But then he remembered that in the mechanical parts store, a "Zombie Siege" map chip cost only 50,000 points.
With 100,000 points, he could buy two.
His eyes slightly red, he clenched his teeth and was about to turn to Lord Mang to say something when he saw Lord Mang already kicking the man.
"Thud."
The pink burly man, who had taken a solid kick, stumbled back uncontrollably and fell to the ground with a thud. After muttering a few words, he got up and wandered off again into the casino.
"Lord Mang."
"I think you might have a screw loose too."
Chen Mang let out a weary sigh and patted Biao Zi on the shoulder: "Next time something like this happens, don't hesitate. It's just 100,000 points. I don't want my right-hand man to have been defiled by some pink burly guy."
"That would make it hard for me to look at you straight in the future."
"Let's go, let's check out the second floor."
"At least it proves our guess was right. There are indeed opportunities to make money in this Fortuitous Encounter map, but you have to dig for them."
"Though if I'd known this would happen, I would've brought a better-looking burly guy from the Survivors. And—"
He gave Biao Zi a strange look.
"You don't look effeminate at all. You're clearly a rough guy. Why did he take a liking to you?"
"Maybe it's the beard. I'll shave it off when we get back."
Biao Zi spoke with a deliberately calm expression, though inside he was already jumping for joy. This was the first time Lord Mang had called him his "right-hand man." Those two words carried far more weight than his position as the captain of the Guardian squad. It seemed Lord Mang had been paying attention to his performance all along!
Right-hand man, huh? Heh.
I'll go back and sound out Lao Zhu, see if Lord Mang has ever said those words to him.
The name of this entertainment city was "Sun City."
The second floor was filled with various shops.
Half of them were open for business. The shops here were relatively normal, just your average "handbag stores" and "clothing stores."
The only thing abnormal was the prices.
"..."
Biao Zi stared in disbelief at the seemingly ordinary short-sleeved shirt in front of him, then turned to the shop assistant in shock: "This shirt, how much is it? 880,000?"
"Are you fucking serious?"
The shirt didn't have a price tag; he only found out the price after asking.
The shop assistant's eyes flashed with a hint of human-like disdain as they pointed to the sun-like logo on the shirt: "See this? The brand is Lieyang. It's top-tier luxury, got it?"
"Do you even know what top-tier luxury means?"
"Hey!"
Biao Zi couldn't help but laugh in exasperation, turning to Lord Mang: "Lord Mang, this guy's actually mocking me."
"Let's go."
Chen Mang waved his hand dismissively: "Generally, luxury stores train their staff to show a bit of superiority when dealing with customers who look poor, to stimulate purchases. But such blatant disdain? Probably a glitch in the program settings, or maybe it's just the unique culture of this mechanical civilization."
"Though those eyes are impressive. They can actually convey disdain."
"Too bad this map prohibits attacks. Otherwise, I'd dig them out and take them back for Xiao Ai. He'd probably like something like that."
They had already seen everything on the second floor.
There wasn't a single thing they could afford.
It was all luxury goods.
A seemingly ordinary comb, labeled "handcrafted" and bearing a logo, was priced at 1.28 million.
An utterly absurd price.
Chen Mang speculated that in the mechanical civilization, many products likely came from "component production lines," meaning everyone used the same items. In such a context, handcrafted goods became a powerful selling point, and using such products was an excellent way to flaunt one's status.
Not bad.
Ordinary gamblers, even if they were lucky enough to earn some money on the first floor, would probably end up spending it all on the second floor.
Money blown in by the wind often gets swept away by the wind as well.
The second floor still offered no opportunities to make money.
It wasn't until they reached the third floor—
That the scene opened up before them.
There were all kinds of small games, somewhat similar to the booth games he had encountered at fairs in the past, like ring toss or balloon darts, but these were packaged to look much more upscale.
Beside each booth stood a beautiful woman in a bikini, and the hall was filled with rhythmic music.
Since ancient times.
Only three things have been able to stir human emotions.
Sex, violence, and death.
And the carriers of these emotions have always been words, audio, and visual experiences.
Among these, the latter two are the most straightforward and brutal.
Clearly, this "entertainment city" was designed to better stimulate the emotions of its guests. The bikini-clad women were everywhere, as if they cost nothing, using visuals and music to continuously arouse people's emotions to a state of excitement.
The air was also filled with a faint scent of perfume.
The oxygen machine in his train was always on, so he could clearly feel that the oxygen levels in this hall were high, keeping everyone in a state of hyperoxia. Combined with the bustling, heated atmosphere of the crowd.
Just stepping into this place.
Was enough to fully stir up one's emotions. Even a monk who had eaten vegetarian meals for ten years would come here, clasp his hands together, and silently recite:
"Wine and meat pass through the intestines, but Buddha remains in the heart."
"..."
Chen Mang glanced around, then leaned on his cane as he walked toward the first booth game. He didn't feel much about these things—not because he was a saint, but because he had been to too many places like this in his previous world. He had already experienced all the excitement, indulgence, and luxury he could.
With his threshold for stimulation raised infinitely high, coming to a place like this no longer elicited much of a reaction from him.
Especially since it was just them here, and the atmosphere wasn't heated enough.
If it were a young man in his place, he would already be flushed and flustered by now.
Like Li Shiji.
Chen Mang stood at the first booth, turned to look at Li Shiji, and was about to say something when he saw Li Shiji standing there, red-faced, his breathing slightly accelerated as he stared at one of the bikini-clad women.
"Sigh."
After letting out a light sigh, he turned to Biao Zi beside him: "Go get that guy for me. And I'll give you another task—when we get back to the train, take him out to have some fun."
"A man who can't even walk straight when he sees a woman."
"He'll never achieve anything great."
Food and lust are human nature. Asking a man to remain calm in the face of female allure is inherently against human nature.
There are only two solutions.
Get tired of it.
Or lose interest.
"Understood!"
"Lord Mang."
Soon, Li Shiji, who had been dragged over, stood awkwardly beside Lord Mang, about to say something when Lord Mang cut him off.
"All virgins are like this. It's normal."
"Take a look at the game rules. Think you can handle it?"
Li Shiji was momentarily stunned, then carefully examined the game rules displayed on the screen in front of the booth.
"Sun Entertainment City Mini-Game."
"Game Name": Quick Eyes, Sharp Mind.
"Game Rules": Minimum bet of 1,000 chips, maximum bet of 10,000 chips. You will then see a three-dimensional image of a cube on the screen in front of you. Inside this cube, there are 18 golf balls arranged in a specific pattern, which will be displayed for three seconds.
You must memorize the positions of the golf balls.
After the screen goes dark, you must place the golf balls on the table in the exact same arrangement as shown on the screen into the cube on the table.
If all the balls are placed correctly, your bet will be doubled.
If there are any mistakes, your entire bet will be forfeited.
During the placement phase, no one other than the participant is allowed to give any verbal hints, otherwise it will be considered an immediate loss.
(End of Chapter)

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 185: "It Should Be the Newbie Protection Period."
chapters.content:
"How is it?"
Chen Mang patted Li Shiji's shoulder, his eyes filled with anticipation: "This shouldn't be too difficult for you, right?"
It was time to strike it rich!
The reason he had specifically called Li Shiji to join him on this fortuitous encounter map was precisely because he was worried about encountering such a situation. Unexpectedly, it had indeed happened. He had originally wanted to bring Lao Zhu along as well, but someone needed to stay behind to watch the house.
"Not difficult."
Li Shiji shook his head and was just about to say something.
Chen Mang extended his wristwatch to the scanning device nearby: "Alright, then I'm going all in. A total of 9,970 points. It's up to you now."
"Huh?"
A trace of panic flashed in Li Shiji's eyes as he said bitterly, "I was just about to suggest trying 1,000 points first. I'm afraid that if I make a mistake, this trip would have been for nothing."
"Don't panic."
Chen Mang shook his head and handed over the freshly lit cigar in his hand, his expression serious: "I've seen your abilities. Don't put too much psychological pressure or burden on yourself. As long as you maintain your normal level, you can definitely clear this smoothly."
"Even if we lose it all, it's fine."
"We'll just go back to mining."
"Here, have a cigar. It'll help clear your mind."
"Be bold, and let's wrap this up early."
"Come on, let's begin."
At that moment—
The screen on the stage began a countdown. Li Shiji took the cigar and inhaled deeply, feeling as though his mind had indeed cleared up a bit. But the next moment, he was choked by the smoke and couldn't stop coughing. On the screen, a cubic box containing 18 golf balls had already appeared.
Li Shiji, his eyes red from the smoke, didn't even have time to rub them. He could only cough violently while staring intently at the cube on the screen.
There was only a three-second time limit.
This kid...
Chen Mang, standing to the side, didn't make a sound to disturb him, but his brows furrowed slightly. The Level 10 supermodel effect of the cigar production line was supposed to help clear the mind. His intention was to help Li Shiji calm down and think more clearly. Who would have thought that this kid would take a deep lungful of smoke?
Did no one tell him that you're not supposed to inhale cigars into your lungs?
Are you made of iron lungs or something?
The bikini-clad beauty next to the stall didn't react much, still wearing a standard, professional smile.
Biao Zi, seeing this scene, was so anxious that he clenched his fists and jumped up and down, but he didn't dare make any noise. If they lost this round, their trip would have been for nothing!
He was hoping to earn 50,000 points so he could go to the "Mechanical Train Parts Store" and beg Lord Mang to buy the Zombie Siege map chip.
If he wanted to pilot the "Thunder" mech as soon as possible, he needed another map to quickly improve his physical fitness index.
If it really came down to it...
If it really came down to it...
Biao Zi gritted his teeth. At worst, it would just be a matter of closing one eye and opening the other—closing the upper eye and opening the lower one. By then, the three seconds had passed, and Li Shiji finally used his sleeve to wipe the tears from his eyes and quickly arranged the golf balls on the table to their corresponding positions.
"Sir."
The bikini-clad beauty beside him smiled with a hint of shyness as she looked at Biao Zi: "Would you like to try? 100,000 points."
"What the hell?"
Biao Zi, who had been intently focused on Li Shiji, was startled by the sudden voice. He turned to look at the woman behind him and couldn't help but curse, "What the hell do you guys want? Do you even know your own worth? Are you worth that much?"
"I'm only worth 100,000, so why the hell are you asking for 100,000?"
But then he realized that his hand, which had been resting behind his back, had accidentally touched the woman. He paused for a moment, then seemed to understand something and poked her again.
"Sir, would you like to? 100,000 points."
A strange glint appeared in his eyes as he began to rapidly poke the woman's body with his fingers.
"Sir, sir, sir, sir..."
The woman seemed to short-circuit, repeating the first word of the sentence over and over.
"Pure repeater!"
Biao Zi smirked, deciding not to toy with her anymore. He turned back nervously to look at Li Shiji, worried that if he messed up, he might be fined.
Finally—
When the last golf ball was placed in the cubic box, the woman standing nearby said crisply, "All 18 golf balls have been placed correctly. Double return of 19,940 points. Please check."
"Not bad."
Chen Mang, satisfied, extended his wristwatch to receive the 19,940 points. Then he placed his watch back on the receiver: "Another round."
With a ding, another 10,000 points were deducted. The maximum bet limit was 10,000 points.
"Good luck."
He patted Li Shiji's shoulder again: "No pressure, just do your best. Pass me the cigar."
Chen Mang took the cigar and handed it to Biao Zi, who was standing beside him.
"Stop letting the kid smoke. It's supposed to be a pick-me-up, but it's making him teary-eyed."
Li Shiji, who had succeeded once, now felt much more confident. He nodded firmly: "Leave it to me, Lord Mang. Today, we'll make a million!"
This project was actually quite simple for him.
Earlier, he had just been under a lot of pressure, worried that if he lost, everyone's efforts would be in vain, and he'd bear the responsibility. But now it didn't matter. Even if he lost this time, there were still 9,940 points left. Plus, he had already succeeded once, so he felt even more confident.
Soon—
He succeeded again, earning another 10,000 points.
Chen Mang was grinning from ear to ear. He invested another 10,000 points and started another round.
This time.
The screen had only been up for a second when Li Shiji calmly closed his eyes, his hands behind his back.
"Hey, hey!"
Biao Zi said urgently, "Aren't you showing off a bit too much? Don't screw this up!"
Two seconds later.
The screen went dark, and Li Shiji opened his eyes, casually placing all the golf balls on the table with perfect accuracy.
"Successfully cleared."
The woman's crisp voice rang in his ears.
"Quite the show-off," Biao Zi said, full of admiration, as he gave a thumbs-up. "But damn, you're good!"
Just as Chen Mang, beaming with joy, was about to start another round, the woman gently stopped his hand from placing the bet and said with a smile, "Sun City rules state that after winning three times in any mini-game, you can no longer participate."
"What if I lose three times?"
"As long as you don't win three times, you can lose as many times as you want."
"Is there a time limit? Can I come back tomorrow?"
"Once you've won three times, you can never play this game again in your life."
"."
Chen Mang turned his head expressionlessly toward the woman with a standard smile on her face. His lips slightly parted as if he wanted to curse, but the thought that she was a robot made his anger dissipate like smoke in the wind. He simply sighed lightly and patted the woman's shoulder.
"You'll get what's coming for doing business like this."
"Sir, would you like to try? 100,000 points."
"Try your mom."
"My mom costs 1 million points."
"."
Chen Mang withdrew his hand and remained silent for a moment before continuing to the second stall. He felt that he couldn't reason with these people anymore. In this city, it seemed that as long as you had money, you could do whatever you wanted. Although he was curious about how a robot could have a mother.
It was insane.
He thought this place shouldn't be called "Eden," but rather "Satan's Paradise."
But it wasn't all bad.
He glanced at the balance on his wristwatch.
39,940.
Almost forty thousand.
He wondered if he could earn a bit more at the other game stalls to make it fifty thousand. That way, he could buy the "Zombie Siege" chip, and this trip wouldn't be a waste.
"Welcome to the experience."
Before he even approached, the woman in a bikini standing in front of the stall placed her hands on her chest and greeted Chen Mang and his group with a professional smile.
All the women were exceptionally tall, wearing sky-high heels and identical red bikinis. Their faces were different, but their figures were almost indistinguishable.
Chen Mang glanced casually and then looked away. If this entertainment city were under his management, he could run it better.
Clothing that was too revealing lost its charm.
What was truly enticing was the hint of what lay beneath.
In front of the second stall, there was another table with a large screen standing upright.
-
"Sun Entertainment City Mini-Game."
"Game Name": Bluff Poker.
"Game Rules": A total of 54 cards. Both sides draw three cards each, and the remaining 48 cards are revealed on the screen for three seconds.
Then the betting begins.
The minimum bet is 1,000 points, and the maximum is 10,000 points.
Both sides reveal their hands. If you lose, you forfeit your bet. If you win, you double your winnings.
Except for the participants, no one else is allowed to speak or give hints during the game, or it will be considered an automatic loss.
-
"Ahem."
Li Shiji, standing behind Chen Mang, cleared his throat: "It's my turn again, Lord Mang."
"Indeed."
Chen Mang stepped aside: "Begin your performance."
The first round started quickly.
The woman standing nearby dealt three cards each to Li Shiji and herself. Immediately after, the screen displayed the remaining 48 cards spread out, lasting only three seconds before flipping back.
This round wasn't about luck.
It was still about quick eyes and a sharp mind. If your brain and eyes were fast enough, you could easily deduce the opponent's hand, minimizing losses and maximizing gains.
Li Shiji closed his eyes and ran through the cards in his mind before looking at his hand.
"Lord Mang, my hand is a pair of threes. The opponent's hand is a mixed set."
"Go all in. It's a sure win."
"Of course." Chen Mang chuckled and extended his wristwatch to place a bet of 10,000 points. Soon, the game ended. The woman's hand was the six of diamonds, the nine of hearts, and the ten of hearts—just as Li Shiji had predicted, a mixed set.
Another 10,000 points were added to his balance.
The next two rounds ended in victory, and the balance easily reached 79,940.
Chen Mang led Biao Zi and the others toward the next stall's game, glancing at Li Shiji with a hint of surprise in his eyes. "Is this beginner's luck or something? Your luck is pretty impressive."
For three consecutive rounds, Li Shiji had the best hand.
Although Li Shiji seemed to have some kind of cheat.
Even if he could calculate the opponent's hand, if luck wasn't on his side, he would still have to bet at least 1,000 points as chips, meaning he would lose 1,000 points. Normally, if it was a win-lose situation, he would still come out ahead overall.
Even if he lost a bit more, it was still a small profit.
Unless he lost 49 times in a row, wiping out all his chips, but such a long streak was relatively rare.
When he joined the fun in the previous world, he had once "slayed the dragon."
It was quite entertaining.
He had stubbornly chased a 28-streak dragon all the way to 43. After that, he lost interest in such things. By the 44th round, his chips were gone, and he simply walked away without checking if the next person succeeded. Watching would only mess with his mindset.
What if the dragon was slayed by the next person on the 44th round? He wouldn't be able to sleep that night.
He'd just stay awake until dawn.
"Hehe," Li Shiji chuckled sheepishly. "It must be the beginner's protection period."
"Alright, that's good. Let's check out the third one."
Soon, they arrived at the third stall.
-
Sun Entertainment City Mini-Game.
Game Name: Boxer.
Game Rules: No armor, exoskeleton armor, or any accessories that enhance the Physical Fitness Index are allowed.
Only the raw strength of the body can be used.
Minimum bet: 1,000 points. Maximum bet: 10,000 points.
If a punch scores 7 points or higher, the bet is doubled and returned. Otherwise, the bet is deducted.
A professional boxer's full-force punch typically scores 7 points.
-
The requirements were high.
But.
The Stellar had no shortage of talent. Chen Mang always believed one thing: in the apocalypse, talent was often an extremely precious resource, and the more, the better.
He couldn't be proficient in everything.
He didn't have the time to learn, nor the ability.
It seemed he could make double the money from this mini-game.
After winning three times, a person could never participate again, but he had Zhang Yi and Zhang Er. These two already had incredibly exaggerated physical abilities, especially after training in the Combat Training Virtual Space, which had elevated their Physical Fitness Index to new heights.
Zhang Yi, who was chewing on a steamed bun and rummaging through the refrigerator to see if there was anything else tasty, suddenly felt someone poking his waist. Looking down, he saw it was Biao Zi and asked in a muffled voice, "What's up, Biao Ge? You want some too?"
"I'm not eating. Go aim for that punching machine and give it a punch."
"Full force?"
"Full force."
"Got it."
Zhang Yi immediately put on a serious expression, tossed the refrigerator onto his brother, and strode over to the punching machine. After taking a deep breath, every muscle in his body tensed up. With a roar, he swung his fist in a wide arc and slammed it into the machine!
A hook punch!
He had never gone hungry on the Stellar, and with such good food every day, he was naturally excited to have a chance to show his strength!
He decided right then and there to put on a good show in front of Lord Mang!
"BOOM!!!"
After receiving such a heavy blow, the punching machine trembled slightly, and finally, the number "15" slowly appeared on the display.
"Is this acceptable?"
Chen Mang silently brought his wristwatch close to the woman's face. After retrieving the chips, he looked at Zhang Yi with a serious expression and affirmed, "Absolutely. Give it two more punches."
"When we get back, I'll treat you to a better meal."
"Biao Zi, remember this: no matter who goes hungry, you must never let this brother of ours starve."
"Did you hear me?"
